**Job Summary:**
 The Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA is responsible for leading and transforming the regional technical delivery organization into a scalable, high\-performing, and standardized function. This role centralizes technical leadership across all countries (including UKI, ME, South Africa, Italy, France and DACH), establishing a unified operating model that ensures consistent implementation quality, strong governance, and measurable delivery outcomes across InterSystems EHR and HealthShare solutions.
   

  

 The position drives operational efficiency through structured resource management, cross\-regional collaboration, and the adoption of shared tools, reusable assets, and standardized processes. It enables the transition from country\-based execution to a coordinated EMEA\-wide delivery model, improving flexibility, utilization, and responsiveness to project demands.
   

  

 In addition, the role plays a critical part in aligning technical delivery with quality objectives, ensuring each country can meet its project targets while benefiting from regional synergies. It is also accountable for embedding AI\-driven methodologies, including the evolution of ARIES, into day\-to\-day delivery practices to enhance predictability, quality, and decision\-making.
   

  

 Overall, this position is key to improving customer outcomes, strengthening partner ecosystems, and building a future\-ready technical implementation capability across EMEA.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead and unify all Technical Implementation teams across EMEA under a single functional structure, ensuring consistent standards and execution.
* Define and enforce technical implementation best practices, governance, and quality frameworks across all projects.
* Maintain strong alignment with country leadership, ensuring technical delivery supports each country in achieving its annual project targets while applying regional synergies and continuous improvements.
* Drive cross\-country collaboration and resource optimization, enabling flexible deployment of technical expertise across the region.
* Own regional technical capacity planning, forecasting, and utilization, leveraging data and AI\-driven insights.
* Oversee partner strategy and execution, including onboarding, performance management, and management alignment.
* Embed and scale the AI\-powered ARIES methodology across all technical delivery activities.
* Establish and monitor KPIs related to delivery quality, efficiency, resource utilization, and partner performance.
* Support country Professional Services Directors in achieving project success, while maintaining strong technical oversight.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, including reusable assets, automation, and standardization of deliverables.
* Act as a senior stakeholder in customer engagements, supporting critical projects and ensuring delivery excellence.


**Qualifications:**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical delivery, implementation, or professional services leadership.
* Proven track record managing large\-scale, complex, multi\-country implementation programs.
* Strong background in healthcare IT or enterprise software implementation environments.
* Deep understanding of technical architectures, integration, and data platforms.
* Experience with resource management, forecasting, and operational optimization at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead organizational transformation and drive standardization.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills in a matrix environment.
* Experience working with partners and external delivery ecosystems.

* Ability to travel internationally 60% of the time.

**Key Success Factors:**

* Effective adoption of AI\-driven implementation practices
* Scalable and standardized technical delivery model across EMEA markets

We are partnering with a leading international consumer organisation undergoing a significant phase of operational evolution and regional transformation across Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia.
 



  





 This appointment represents a strategically critical leadership hire, responsible for shaping and embedding a future\-ready operational model capable of supporting long\-term regional growth, scalability, efficiency, and commercial agility across diverse and evolving markets.
 



  





 Operating at Executive Committee level, the role will lead the transition and centralisation of key operational capabilities into Dubai, redefining how the organisation structures, governs, and executes operations across the region.
 



  





 This is not a traditional supply chain leadership position. It is a broad operational transformation mandate focused on organisational design, operating model evolution, infrastructure optimisation, and cross\-functional integration across complex international markets.
 



  





 The Opportunity
 



  





 The Director of Operational Transformation will be responsible for architecting and executing a large\-scale operational transformation agenda across MEA \& Asia.
 



 The successful individual will act as a strategic partner to regional and global leadership, driving the redesign of operational frameworks, improving organisational capability, enhancing supply network effectiveness, and establishing scalable infrastructure aligned with the organisation’s long\-term ambitions.
 



 The role requires a leader capable of balancing strategic vision with operational execution, while operating effectively across both mature and emerging markets.
 



 This individual will play a central role in influencing how the organisation evolves operationally over the coming years.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Strategic Operational Transformation
 


* Define and execute a regional operational transformation roadmap aligned with business growth objectives and long\-term organisational priorities
* Lead the redesign and optimisation of the regional operating model across operational functions
* Drive the transition and centralisation of operational capabilities into Dubai, ensuring effective governance, scalability, and regional alignment
* Partner closely with Executive Committee stakeholders to shape strategic operational priorities and long\-term capability development
* Evaluate current operational structures, identify inefficiencies, and implement future\-focused solutions to enhance agility and performance



 Operating Model \& Infrastructure Development
 


* Design scalable operational frameworks capable of supporting multi\-market growth across MEA \& Asia
* Establish governance structures, decision\-making frameworks, and operational standards across regional markets
* Develop integrated operational ecosystems connecting planning, logistics, procurement, distribution, customer operations, and commercial functions
* Support the evolution of regional hub structures, shared service capabilities, and centralised operational functions
* Lead organisational alignment initiatives to ensure operational structures support both regional and local market needs



 Supply Chain, Logistics \& Distribution Transformation
 


* Oversee the transformation and optimisation of regional supply chain and distribution networks
* Drive operational excellence initiatives across warehousing, transportation, inventory management, and fulfilment operations
* Evaluate and redesign logistics infrastructure and 3PL operating models to improve service levels, responsiveness, and cost efficiency
* Establish operational KPI frameworks to monitor service performance, operational efficiency, and network effectiveness
* Drive automation and digital enablement initiatives to improve operational visibility, planning capability, and execution consistency



 Procurement, Partnerships \& External Ecosystems
 


* Lead the development of strategic operational partnerships across logistics, distribution, manufacturing, and external service providers
* Oversee supplier and partner governance frameworks to ensure accountability, scalability, and performance delivery
* Support procurement transformation initiatives focused on cost optimisation, operational resilience, and strategic sourcing capability
* Negotiate and manage complex operational and commercial agreements with regional and global partners



 Transformation Delivery \& Change Leadership
 


* Lead complex, cross\-functional transformation programmes across multiple geographies and stakeholder groups
* Drive adoption of new operational processes, technologies, governance models, and organisational structures
* Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Coach and develop regional operational leadership teams to strengthen organisational capability and succession planning
* Act as a visible transformation leader capable of influencing senior stakeholders across regional and global functions



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 The successful candidate will bring significant experience leading operational transformation, operating model redesign, and regional operational leadership within complex multinational environments.
 



 Candidates will typically come from leading FMCG, consumer goods, beauty, retail, or similarly sophisticated international organisations.
 



 Experience \& Background
 


* Proven experience leading large\-scale operational transformation initiatives across international markets
* Strong operational leadership background spanning supply chain, logistics, procurement, planning, distribution, and operational governance
* Demonstrated experience designing or evolving regional operating models and organisational structures
* Experience leading regional hub centralisation, shared services transformation, or cross\-border operational migration projects
* Strong understanding of operational infrastructure, supply network optimisation, and multi\-market operational complexity
* Experience operating within matrix organisations and engaging with Executive Committee or Board\-level stakeholders
* Strong commercial understanding with the ability to align operational strategy to broader business objectives



 Leadership Capabilities
 


* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into executable operational frameworks
* Highly credible stakeholder manager with strong influencing and communication capabilities
* Commercially astute with a balanced understanding of growth, efficiency, and operational sustainability
* Comfortable operating in complex, evolving, and high\-growth environments
* Strong organisational leadership capability with experience developing high\-performing regional teams
* Resilient, adaptable, and capable of leading transformation through ambiguity and organisational change

 The Associate Director / Technical Director – Rail will provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary rail projects while helping to grow the rail business in the UAE and wider Middle East market.
   

  

 The role requires broad experience across rail design and delivery, including track, civil works, stations, systems, signalling, power and operations, together with proven delivery of major rail programmes such as high\-speed rail, metro and light rail in regional and international markets.
   

  

 This position suits an experienced rail leader with strong technical credibility, established client relationships, and the ability to support project delivery, technical assurance and work\-winning across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.
* Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical approvals and assurance activities across complex rail programmes.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and regional regulations, codes and approvals processes.


**Multidisciplinary Rail Design Oversight**
 Provide technical oversight and coordination across all rail disciplines, including:
   

  

* Track \& Alignment
* Civil \& Structural Works (bridges, viaducts, tunnels, earthworks)
* Stations \& Buildings (architecture, MEP, fire \& life safety)
* Rail Systems (signalling, traction power, OCS, substations, SCADA)
* Communications \& Telecoms
* Depots \& Rolling Stock Interfaces
* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.
   

  

**Business Development \& Client Engagement**
* Play a leading role in business development and work\-winning across the Middle East rail market.
* Shape bid strategies, technical solutions, delivery methodologies and fee proposals for priority rail opportunities.
* Act as a senior technical representative in client meetings, workshops, presentations and bid interviews.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, rail authorities, operators, developers and contractors across the UAE and wider region.
* Contribute to pipeline growth, key account development, market intelligence and strategic positioning for rail in the Middle East.


**Project Delivery Support**
* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.
* Resolve complex technical, interface and systems integration issues across multidisciplinary rail projects.
* Support technical review of contractor submissions, authority submissions and design deliverables.
* Provide technical input during construction, testing and commissioning phases where required.
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.

* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**

* Support recruitment, succession planning and capability growth to meet the expanding Middle East rail market.
* Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned and regional best practice across the business.

* Degree in Civil, Railway or Systems Engineering; a Master’s degree is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.

**Technical Excellence**
* Provide technical leadership across engineering solutions, mobility strategies, and design methodologies, ensuring that projects are innovative, practical, and aligned with client objectives.
* Ensure robust technical assurance and compliance with international standards, local authority requirements, design safety obligations, and organisational quality systems.

**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and inspire high\-performing multi\-disciplinary teams, setting clear expectations for delivery, collaboration, and professional standards.
* Build organisational capability through effective resource planning, performance management, knowledge sharing, and development of specialist and leadership talent.

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, or a related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 20\+ years of experience delivering major transport and infrastructure projects, with at least 10 years in the Middle East.
* Proven leadership experience on mega‑projects such as highways programmes, mobility corridors, rail/metro interfaces, smart mobility projects, and integrated infrastructure developments.
* Strong background in multi‑disciplinary design management, including roads, highways, bridges and utilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large consultant and contractor teams within complex programme environments, with strong capability in resource planning, delivery oversight, and interface management.
* Excellent knowledge of international and regional codes, design standards, and approval processes.
* Sound understanding of design safety, HSE leadership, regulatory compliance, and authority approvals processes across major infrastructure programmes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and client‑facing skills with experience engaging with ministries and major authorities.
* Strong commercial and contractual acumen, including experience with bid leadership, consultancy frameworks, contract strategy, procurement interfaces, change management, and programme financial performance.
* Experience managing programme performance through governance, reporting, KPIs, and executive\-level decision\-making in high\-profile delivery environments.
* Experience working with large engineering consultancies on high\-profile regional projects.
* Chartered/Professional Engineer status (CEng, PE, PEng, etc.) is highly desirable.

 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

**Job Description**
 WSP is seeking an experienced Head of Transport Planning \& Mobility – Middle East to provide strategic, technical, commercial, and people leadership across the region. Based in Dubai, the role will lead and grow WSP’s transport planning, traffic engineering, and integrated mobility services across the Middle East, supporting major infrastructure, urban development, smart cities, and sustainability‑led programmes.
   

  

 The role will shape the regional vision for transport planning and mobility, align with WSP’s global strategy, strengthen client relationships with key public and private stakeholders, and ensure the successful delivery of complex, multidisciplinary projects across the Middle East.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership \& Vision**
* Develop and drive the regional Transport Planning \& Mobility strategy, aligned with WSP Middle East and global transport objectives.
* Position WSP as a market leader in transport planning, integrated mobility, and future‑ready transport solutions.
* Anticipate emerging trends such as net‑zero transport, smart mobility, MaaS, autonomous transport, active travel, and transit‑oriented development, and embed them into regional offerings.
* Represent WSP at senior client meetings, industry forums, conferences, and with government stakeholders.


**Regional Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and inspire a multi‑country team of transport planners, traffic engineers, mobility specialists, and data analysts.
* Set clear objectives for regional discipline leads and ensure consistent technical quality and delivery excellence.
* Drive talent attraction, succession planning, and capability development across the Middle East.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high‑performance culture aligned with WSP’s values.
* Promote cross‑discipline working with rail, highways, bridges, advisory, ESG, digital, and urban development teams.


**Client Relationship Management**
* Act as senior client sponsor for key public‑sector and private‑sector clients.
* Build long‑term trusted relationships with ministries, authorities, developers, operators, and investors.
* Support and lead major client engagements including:
+ Transport authorities and municipalities
+ Ministries of Transport and Infrastructure
+ Master developers and PPP consortia
+ Private developers and investment funds


**Business Development \& Market Growth**
* Lead regional business development initiatives, including market entry strategies, client targeting, and service diversification.
* Provide leadership on major bids and tenders, including pursuits, win themes, pricing strategies, and interview presentations.
* Grow market share within priority sectors such as:
+ Urban mobility \& land‑use integration
+ Mega‑developments and giga‑projects
+ Public transport and rail planning
+ Aviation and port‑related access planning
+ Active travel and demand management
+ ITS and Smart Mobility

* Contribute to revenue growth, margin performance, and pipeline development.


**Technical Oversight \& Quality Assurance**
* Provide technical oversight and governance for complex and high‑profile projects.
* Ensure regional delivery follows WSP global standards, best practice, and local authority requirements.
* Act as a technical authority on major transport planning and mobility issues, supporting project teams where required.
* Champion innovation in modelling, analytics, digital delivery, and decision‑support tools.


**Project Delivery \& Commercial Management**
* Full ownership and accountability of the discipline P\&L, including related KPIs and targets.

+ Technical excellence
+ Programme and budget control
+ Risk management and mitigation
+ Client satisfaction

**Qualifications**
* Degree in Transport Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Planning, or a related discipline.
* Professional chartership (e.g. CIHT, TPS, ICE, RTPI or equivalent).
* 15\+ years’ experience in transport planning and mobility, with a strong track record in the Middle East.
* Proven leadership experience managing large, multidisciplinary teams across multiple geographies.
* Experience working on multi\-discipline mega‑projects, transport master plans, smart city programmes, Vision‑led national strategies (e.g. Vision 2030\) in the region.
* Experience with digital transport modelling, mobility platforms, and data‑driven planning.
* Demonstrated success in winning and delivering major transport projects.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience managing P\&L, bids, and client frameworks.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strategic thinker with a growth mindset.

**Director \- Business Solutions and Delivery**
**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Chief Operations Officer
   

  

**About The Role**
 The role will lead the end\-to\-end execution of strategic projects, programmes and product delivery across the company’s credit\-lending platform and its market deployments. Responsible for ensuring that complex, cross\-functional initiatives are planned and executed with precision, the role works closely with technology, operations, compliance, product, credit risk and partner integrations.
   

  

 The Director will serve as the central point of accountability for roadmap delivery, operational readiness, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices across the business. This is a senior leadership position that requires deep experience in digital lending or financial services delivery, strong technology and operational fluency, and the ability to drive alignment across multiple stakeholders in a fast\-growing, regulated environment.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will demonstrate expertise in managing and coordinating cross\-functional teams, developing comprehensive project plans, allocating resources efficiently, overseeing budgets, and excelling in risk management. He/she must have the skills to effectively manage multiple projects (initiatives, change requests) along with their dependencies and stakeholder engagements. Additionally, the candidate should possess strong analytical skills and the ability to compile and analyze projects (be familiar with Jira, Confluence, MS\-project, MS\-office).
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Strategic Delivery \& Programme Leadership:
   

  

* Own the delivery of the enterprise roadmap, ensuring alignment with the COO, Commercial and Technology teams.
* Lead planning, execution and delivery of new projects and major programmes such as new product launches, regulatory changes, platform enhancements, change requests and market expansions.
* Oversee projects across cross\-functional technical and business streams for end\-to\-end delivery, fostering a collaborative work environment, ensuring effective communication and synergy among team members.
* Ensure programmes are fully scoped, resourced, risk\-assessed, and tracked through to completion.
* Provide clear status reporting, dependency management, and decision frameworks to senior leadership.
* Own the prioritisation forum, process and governance alongside resource planning and allocation.
* Customize, utilize and maintain Jira to create dynamic project dashboards, providing real\-time visibility into project status, progress, and key metrics that meet project and stakeholder requirements, incorporating analytical insights.


 Project \& Portfolio Management
   

  

* Develop a structured delivery framework (Agile/Hybrid/Waterfall) suitable for the company’s product and regulatory environment.
* Manage the project portfolio, prioritising initiatives based on strategic value, risk, resource availability, and ROI.
* Ensure robust project governance, documentation, and control processes are in place.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Data, Compliance, and Commercial teams to coordinate programme execution.
* Facilitate cross\-departmental alignment on requirements, timelines, decision points, and resource planning.
* Act as a key escalation point for conflicting priorities, blockers, or delivery risks.


 Operational Readiness \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Ensure that new features, products, and system changes are ready for operational deployment, with adequate testing, training, risk assessment, and support structures.
* Oversee UAT, release management, and change control processes.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery workflows, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.


 Risk, Compliance \& Regulatory Alignment
   

  

* Ensure delivery processes incorporate relevant regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., FCA, consumer credit, data protection, lending rules).
* Maintain strong risk identification, mitigation, and reporting across all delivery initiatives.
* Collaborate with Risk, Banking partners and Compliance teams to ensure regulatory changes are implemented correctly and on time.


 Leadership \& Team Management
   

  

* Lead and mentor a high\-performing team of project managers, functional / delivery leads and PMO staff.
* Build capability within the team through coaching, training, and structured development frameworks.
* Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and excellence in execution.


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelors in Business / Computer science / Engineering / MBA (or equivalent)
* 10\+ years’ experience in project, programme, or delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience in financial services, lending, fintech, or credit\-platform environments.
* Strong understanding of the full lending lifecycle (originations, underwriting, credit decisioning, servicing, collections).
* Demonstrated success delivering complex, cross\-functional technology programmes.
* Deep knowledge of project management methodologies and tools (Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, Lean).
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, including at C\-suite and board level.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking capability.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and negotiation skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in a highly regulated environment.
* Previous responsibility for PMO leadership, Programme Management or portfolio/project governance.
* Experience with SaaS lending platforms, decision engines, or orchestration tools.
* Certifications such as Prince2, PMP, Agile PM, Scrum Master, or equivalent.
* Exposure to data\-driven decisioning, machine learning credit models, or digital onboarding journeys.


**The Ideal Candidate Is Someone Who**
* Thinks strategically with strong operational discipline.
* Is highly organised with the ability to manage multiple concurrent programmes.
* Leads with presence with the ability to drive clarity in ambiguous environments.
* Has a delivery\-focused mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
* Inspires through collaboration, adopting pragmatic and solutions\-oriented ideas.
* Has high integrity and sound judgement in a regulated context.


**Company Overview**
 Ezra provides B2B digital lending solutions for emerging markets in partnership with mobile and digital wallet operators and financial service providers. Ezra supports 24 operations in 23 countries, across Africa, the Middle East and Asia. Our key office locations are in Nairobi, Kenya and Dubai, UAE.
   

  

 Our flagship products are Airtime Credit Services (ACS), Nano and BNPL.
   

  

* ACS is an airtime or data advance offered to prepaid mobile subscribers at the point of low credit.
* Nano is a micro cash advance offered to mobile wallet users on demand.
* BNPL facilitates payment installments for products and services


 As a FinTech company, our business is entirely technology and data driven, from determining subscriber eligibility, generating relevant offers, managing risk, loan issuance, recovery, optimizing performance and reporting, reconciliation and billing.
   

  

 Each day we process approximately 21M loan requests and 1\.4 TB of data across our markets. This process needs to be robust, reliable and secure.
   

  

 But it doesn’t end there. We’re exploring new ways of using our platform and transactional data to improve our products and develop new product opportunities.

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

 As RVP of Professional Services for Emerging Markets (middles east and Africa), you will be the most senior technical leader responsible for building, scaling, and driving the performance of DataRobot’s Professional Services organization, overseeing both the Forward Deployed Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams.  Commercial Strategy \& P\&L Ownership

 Professional Services Team Leadership \& Scaling

 Delivery Excellence \& Operational Rigor

 You will serve as the critical bridge between global strategy and regional execution.  :
   

  

 Technical Expertise

* Exceptional executive\-level communication skills — able to translate technical complexity into clear business outcomes for C\-level audiences.


 Commercial Acumen
   

  

  

* Strong understanding of the commercial dynamics of a post\-sales technical function, including utilization management, delivery efficiency, and the relationship between technical success and revenue retention and expansion.


**Requisite Education and Experience / Minimum Qualifications:**
**Experience**
* 10–14 years of progressive experience in software engineering, platform deployment, or AI/ML technical roles, with a minimum of 4 years in a senior management or VP\-level leadership position.


 Education
   

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field required; MS or PhD preferred.


 Cloud Experience
   

  

  

* Expert\-level, hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform including enterprise security, networking, and compliance considerations.


 Regional Experience
   

  

  

* Demonstrated experience working across the MEA region, with an appreciation for the cultural, regulatory, and commercial diversity of key markets including GCC and Europe


 DataRobot Platform
   

  

  

* Expert familiarity with the DataRobot AI Platform is a strong plus.

* Be Better Together

**Job Description:**
 DataRobot delivers AI that maximizes impact and minimizes business risk. Our platform and applications integrate into core business processes so teams can develop, deliver, and govern AI at scale. DataRobot empowers practitioners to deliver predictive and generative AI, and enables leaders to secure their AI assets. Organizations worldwide rely on DataRobot for AI that makes sense for their business — today and in the future.
   

  

**Purpose \& Overall Relevance for the Organization:**
 DataRobot’s Forward Deployed Engagement Manager leads the delivery of our most advanced customer initiatives. In this high\-impact role, you will be the captain of the ship for enterprise customer engagements, specifically focusing on the deployment of Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions.
   

  

 You are not just a project manager; you are a technical translator and a strategic partner. You will sit at the intersection of business strategy and engineering execution, guiding our customers through the complexities of adopting autonomous AI agents. Drawing on a background in software engineering or solution architecture, you will effectively manage technical risk while using your business acumen to ensure every project delivers measurable ROI.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead Complex AI Engagements: Own the end\-to\-end delivery lifecycle for high\-stakes professional services engagements. You will manage the scope, timeline, budget, and execution of projects building GenAI agents and predictive solutions.
* Bridge Business \& Technology: Act as the primary translation layer between client business stakeholders (up to the C\-suite) and DataRobot’s technical delivery team (AI Engineers and Data Scientists). You will ensure business goals are accurately translated into technical requirements.
* Technical Risk Management: Leverage your technical background to identify implementation risks early—whether related to data infrastructure, API integrations, or agent logic—and work with the engineering team to mitigate them before they impact the critical path.
* Stakeholder Management: cultivate strong, trusted relationships with client sponsors. You will manage expectations, handle escalations, and navigate complex organizational dynamics to ensure project success.
* Drive Adoption \& Change: Go beyond delivery by helping customers understand how to operationalize and adopt Agentic workflows, advising on process changes required to integrate AI agents into their daily operations.
* Agile Delivery: Run agile sprints, stand\-ups, and sprint reviews, ensuring the delivery team maintains high velocity and clear direction.

 Technical Fluency:
   

  

  

* Understanding of system architectures, API integrations, and cloud infrastructure

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 At Dyson, we’re driven by a relentless pursuit of innovation—pushing boundaries in engineering, AI, and robotics. Our new Data Intelligence team sits at the heart of this mission: shaping Dyson’s future through data. Here, we blend creativity, precision, and audacity to power intelligent products. We craft data strategies and pipelines that fuel the next generation of connected devices.
   

  

 You’ll work alongside brilliant minds from Dyson global engineering team and external software/hardware partners in an environment built for exploration, discovery, delivery and impact.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Lead Data Intelligence Project Manager, you ensure that every project has the resources it needs to take off, you'll orchestrate data operations that power product development across Dyson’s global teams. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Act as the primary liaison between our external project teams and our internal technical departments (Data Curation and MLOps). You will own the "data logistics" for the entire project lifecycle—from initial storage setup to final delivery of high\-quality training sets.
* You will be the strategic lead for our labelling workforce, managing the balance between our in\-house contractors and 3rd party service providers to ensure we never hit a capacity bottleneck.
* Overseeing data storage setup and maintenance to guarantee security, accessibility, and compliance.
* Maintaining rigorous documentation and workflows that ensure project transparency and repeatability.
* Supporting cross\-functional communication between data teams, contractors, and engineering partners.


**About you**
* 8\+ years in Project or Program Management, with at least 2 years specifically in AI/ML Data Operations or Data Management. You’ve delivered complex projects on time and within scope—often in fast\-changing settings.
* Demonstrated success in managing 3rd party vendors or service providers, including contract negotiation, quality assurance, issue resolution, and ongoing relationship management.
* Machine Learning Lifecycle Knowledge: Strong understanding of how data flows from collection → cleaning → labeling → training → deployment.
* Tooling Familiarity: Experience with labeling platforms (Labelbox, CVAT, Label Studio) and project management tools (Jira, Asana, or Airtable).
* Data Literacy: Basic understanding of data storage architectures (S3, SQL, Snowflake) and data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA).
* Communication: Exceptional "translation" skills—the ability to explain technical MLOps constraints to business stakeholders and vice versa.
* A solid understanding of modern data storage solutions (cloud, on\-premises, hybrid), including principles of data security, privacy, access control, and regulatory compliance.
* Able to translate complex technical requirements into clear actions for both technical and non\-technical audiences. You’re adept at influencing and building consensus.
* Confident interfacing with cross\-functional teams—coordinating with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and external stakeholders to deliver smooth handovers and alignment.
* Well\-versed in project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall). Known for driving continuous improvement, clear documentation, and repeatable processes.
* Thorough, highly organized, and relentless in troubleshooting issues and removing blockers before they impact delivery.
* Proactive, accountable, and comfortable juggling competing priorities. You always keep end goals in focus and balance urgency with quality.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Data Engineering, Engineering, or Information Technology); higher degree or PMP/Prince2 certification is a plus.


 Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

data.jd_text:
**PURPOSE AND SCOPE OF POSITION** 




 The Project Manager (Software Development) is responsible for planning, governing, and delivering software development initiatives executed by the in\-house development team, with a strong focus on mobile and web platforms.
 



 The role supports the delivery of business\-critical digital products, internal platforms, customer\-facing applications, and system integrations across the organization.
 



 This position goes beyond traditional project coordination and holds end\-to\-end accountability for delivery execution, sprint planning, team productivity, quality assurance, and risk management. The Project Manager works closely with the Head of Product Development, Product Team, Designers, and QA to ensure initiatives are delivered predictably, efficiently, and in alignment with product strategy and technical standards.
 



  





 The role ensures initiatives are delivered on time and within scope, with complete documentation, while meeting quality standards and supporting strategic objectives such as scalability, maintainability, operational efficiency, and enhanced user experience.
 



  





**1\. MAIN DUTIES** 




 A. Project and Delivery Management
 


* Plan and manage end\-to\-end delivery of in\-house software initiatives across mobile (iOS, Android) and web platforms.
* Develop and maintain detailed delivery plans including sprint schedules, milestones, dependencies, and release timelines.
* Ensure delivery commitments are met in line with agreed scope, timelines, and quality expectations.
* Track and report project progress, risks, and issues to senior stakeholders clearly and transparently.
* Own and govern delivery documentation, ensuring requirements, designs, APIs, and release artefacts are clearly documented, version\-controlled, and maintained.



 B. Agile Execution and Team Enablement
 


* Drive Agile and Scrum delivery practices across in\-house teams.
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support capacity planning, workload balancing, and delivery forecasting.
* Remove delivery blockers and enable the team to operate at optimal velocity and focus.



 C. Stakeholder and Product Collaboration
 


* Work closely with the Head of Product Development, Product Team, business stakeholders, and UX teams to translate business requirements into executable delivery plans.
* Ensure alignment between product roadmap priorities and engineering execution.
* Manage stakeholder expectations related to scope, timelines, risks, and trade\-offs.



 D. Quality, Risk and Dependency Management
 


* Ensure adherence to engineering best practices, coding standards, and QA processes.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks related to delivery timelines, resource constraints, technical dependencies, quality, and rework.
* Ensure appropriate testing coverage, UAT readiness, and release stability.



 E. Architecture and Technical Alignment
 


* Work closely with product and technical leads to ensure alignment with target architecture.
* Support development of scalable, maintainable, and well\-documented solutions.
* Prevent technical debt accumulation through disciplined delivery governance.



 F. Continuous Improvement
 


* Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, tools, and processes.
* Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement within the development team.
* Support adoption of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automation where applicable.



  





**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED** 




**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of overall industry experience, with at least 3 years in end\-to\-end software project management.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery frameworks and the software development lifecycle.
* Experience delivering customer\-facing digital products across web and mobile platforms.
* Background as a software developer or strong technical aptitude with progression into a Project Manager role.



**Supportive Skills and Competencies** 



* Strong delivery leadership and execution mindset.
* Experience with RESTful APIs and web services.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and cloud\-based platforms.
* Ability to capture business requirements and translate them into high\-level technical solutions.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* High attention to detail with strong documentation and reporting capabilities.

 Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

 Under broad direction, plans and manages assigned real estate and infrastructure projects.  Particular focus on coastal engineering and offshore island/causeway construction, but including design, construction, renovation, or replacement of company office, laboratory, manufacturing, warehouse, service center, and site infrastructure facilities.

data.jd_text:
**Human Resources Director** 




**Location:** 
 Dubai, United Arab Emirates
 



  





 Role Overview:
 



 We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Director to lead the HR function for a growing construction business based in Dubai. This role will focus heavily on talent acquisition, workforce planning, compensation and benefits strategy, and building scalable HR frameworks to support project\-based operations across the UAE and wider region.
 



 The HR Director will act as a strategic partner to executive leadership, ensuring the organisation attracts, develops, and retains top\-tier talent while maintaining compliance with UAE labour laws and industry regulations.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
 


* Develop and implement a comprehensive talent acquisition strategy aligned with business growth and project pipeline demands.
* Lead high\-volume recruitment across technical, engineering, project management, and corporate functions.
* Build strong talent pipelines for critical construction roles (e.g., project directors, engineers, quantity surveyors, site managers).
* Establish employer branding initiatives to position the company as an employer of choice within the construction sector.
* Oversee recruitment partners, agencies, and international hiring campaigns where required.
* Implement workforce planning models to ensure manpower forecasting aligns with project timelines.



 2\. Compensation \& Benefits
 


* Design and implement competitive compensation and benefits frameworks aligned with market benchmarks in the UAE construction industry.
* Lead salary benchmarking exercises and ensure internal equity across roles and geographies.
* Develop incentive schemes linked to project performance and business outcomes.
* Oversee benefits administration including health insurance, allowances, bonuses, and expatriate packages.
* Ensure compliance with WPS (Wage Protection System) and UAE Labour Law requirements.



 3\. HR Strategy \& Leadership
 


* Develop and execute the overall HR strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Establish HR policies, procedures, and governance frameworks suitable for a project\-driven environment.
* Lead organisational design initiatives to support business expansion.
* Provide strategic counsel to senior leadership on people\-related matters.



 4\. Employee Relations \& Compliance
 


* Ensure full compliance with UAE Labour Law and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee employee relations matters including disciplinary processes and conflict resolution.
* Develop retention and engagement strategies to reduce turnover across site\-based and corporate employees.



 5\. Performance Management \& Development
 


* Implement performance management frameworks aligned with KPIs and project milestones.
* Support leadership development and succession planning initiatives.
* Promote a culture of accountability, safety, and high performance.



  





 Candidate Profile
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* 12\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within construction, engineering, or infrastructure sectors.
* Strong expertise in talent acquisition within project\-based environments.
* Proven experience designing compensation and benefits frameworks in the UAE market.
* In\-depth knowledge of UAE Labour Law and HR compliance requirements.
* Experience managing multi\-site or geographically dispersed workforces.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* Professional HR certification (CIPD, SHRM, or equivalent) preferred.

data.jd_text:
**About Dubai Holding Real Estate:** 




 Dubai Holding’s real estate business has developed strategic destinations and communities that offer unique and attractive lifestyle opportunities to meet the evolving needs of Dubai’s residents and visitors alike. As a master developer, we invest in sustainable infrastructure, accessibility, community amenities and family\-focused facilities including community centres, mosques, schools, supermarkets and landscaping.
 



 Our integrated real estate offering also includes a robust land sales portfolio, project management for large\-scale projects, as well as top\-notch facilities management services.
 



  





**About the Job:** 




 An opportunity has arisen for a
 **Senior Manager \- Project Development** 
 to join Dubai Holding Real Estate. The job holder will be responsible to lead and manage the development process of projects to ensure that the business plan objectives such as launch schedule, design quality and budget are achieved.
 



  





 The main duties and responsibilities of this role:
 


* Review design submissions for technical and commercial compliance during the design stage, and lead value engineering exercises to achieve target budgets to ensure that all design submissions comply with technical and commercial requirements.
* Review architectural submissions for 'look and feel' items within the delivery stage, protect the design intent, and ensure that purchasers receive what they have purchased to ensure alignment with the design intent.
* Operate within the stipulated framework to maintain legal and ethical standards and ensure compliance with required DHRE regulatory framework and corporate governance.
* Lead, prepare and provide inputs to business cases including financial, design, and procurement strategies for projects within the portfolio to ensure that all business cases align with the company's strategy. Obtain stakeholder approvals by coaching project teams.
* Propose and define strategies for delivering the development pipeline and managing the development teams (Legal, Financial, Market Research, Marketing, Sales, Project Managers, Architects, Quantity Surveyors and all Engineering Disciplines) to ensure that they are working towards the same goals and possess the resources needed to succeed.
* Lead all aspects of the development process, including feasibility, master planning, design, procurement, consultant/contractor appointment, and project execution to ensure that all technical procedures meet approved corporate operational objectives.
* Oversee and review the preparation of project\-specific development and design briefs that reflect project intent and objectives.
* Identify and document risk items for each business case, including individual property levels, analyzing and ranking overall risk exposure (i.e., technical, financial, and human resources), and actively leading risk mitigation measures to ensure that business cases are secured to meet profit and turnover targets.
* Manage consultants and ensure that risks are mitigated, and senior management is informed of any changes.
* Provide regular feedback on business plans, project status, risks, and approved feasibility to ensure that project goals are being met. · Manage stakeholder relationships at all levels, including liaising with stakeholder partners and key business affiliates.



  





**About you:** 




 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:
 


* Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture/ Engineering/ Real Estate Development; Master’s degree preferred.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification
* Excellent knowledge of real estate development processes, regulations, and industry standards.
* Min. 10\-12 years’ experience in real estate/ development management/ design / project management, of which 4 years’ at senior capacity within the Real Estate industry
* Well versed in Ms. Office suite and AutoCAD software
* Project management skills including planning, scheduling, and risk management.
* Financial acumen with the ability to manage project budgets, cash flow, and financial statements.
* Strategic thinking and the ability to develop and implement business plans and strategies.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and manage teams of diverse professionals.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and manage stakeholder expectations.
* Attention to detail with the ability to review and analyze technical and financial documents.
* Negotiation skills with the ability to manage contracts and agreements.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously.



  





**About the Benefits:** 




 At Dubai Holding, we're committed to nurturing the success and well\-being of our colleagues. Join our dynamic and diverse team, and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive compensation, career development opportunities, and a collaborative work environment. We strongly believe in creating an empowered workforce that will help us build a connected city for tomorrow. We are committed to attracting the brightest minds and nurturing the most pioneering candidates who desire to make a great impact on the future of Dubai.

**Job Description**
**Job Description**
**About The Role**
 Based at our Corporate Office in Dubai, the Senior Legal Counsel is responsible to provide support and assistance in relation to all aspects of DP World \- Maritime Solutions business activities with the focus on shipping transactional work (charter\-parties, financing, sale \& purchase, new\-builds, vessel flagging, regulatory, insurance, corporate, JVs) plus disputes/litigation.
   

  

 The Senior Legal Counsel will provide high quality, targeted and accessible legal advice across a range of maritime practice areas and will work as a valued business partner with colleagues across DP World \- Maritime Solutions in order to secure and deliver effective solutions to legal issues. The Senior Legal Counsel will need to be highly experienced and technically proficient in their areas of maritime legal specialism and also act as the senior in\-house expert for a specific practice discipline e.g. arbitration, ship finance, Sale \& Purchase, vessel flagging. They will be expected to work with a high degree of autonomy on complex legal matters. The Senior Legal Counsel will lead and manage their own portfolio of matters, but they will also work collegiately with rest of the legal team and Head of Legal on larger legal projects, particularly those which require input from multiple specialisms or experience. The Senior Legal Counsel will also assist in and supervise the work of the Junior Legal Counsel and Paralegals in the legal team.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**

data.jd_text:
Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award\-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm.
   

  

 We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo \& Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management.
   

  

 We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 AESG is seeking an experienced BIM Manager with deep expertise in data center and mission critical facility design to join our Mission Critical department. Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead BIM implementation, coordination, and delivery across diverse data center projects throughout the EMEA region, as well as occasional building services projects including hotels, offices, and commercial developments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in BIM processes and digital design delivery with proven experience managing complex multidisciplinary coordination for hyperscale data center operators. This role requires hands\-on involvement in model production, team supervision, and technical delivery, while acting as the Lead Appointed Party under ISO 19650 for assigned projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as Lead Appointed Party for BIM delivery in accordance with ISO 19650, with formal authority to accept, reject, or delay information deliveries that do not meet agreed standards and client Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
* Develop and maintain project\-level BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), Master Information Delivery Plans (MIDP), and review/approve Task Information Delivery Plans (TIDP) submitted by design disciplines
* Establish and manage Common Data Environment (CDE) structures using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, including project setup, access control, folder structures, workflow configuration, status codes, and information containers (Work in Progress, Shared, Published, Archive)
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, chairing clash detection reviews, coordination meetings, and issue resolution sessions with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and specialist disciplines
* Enforce BIM standards, protocols, and quality control procedures, ensuring compliance with ISO 19650, BSRIA BG6 guidance for MEP, hyperscaler\-specific requirements and client specifications
* Supervise and mentor project BIM teams on Revit best practices, family creation, parametric modeling, and workflow optimization, while maintaining hands\-on involvement in complex modeling tasks
* Manage COBie\-compliant asset data structuring and delivery for facilities management handover, supporting construction phase information delivery and digital twin integration
* Prepare and deliver BIM coordination reports, clash reports, design validation summaries, model quality audits, and lessons learned documentation
* Support business development through BIM capability presentations, technical demonstrations, and proposal preparation
* Identify and escalate BIM delivery risks early, implementing structured risk management procedures


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years progressive experience as BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, or senior BIM role with significant focus on data center and mission critical facilities
* Proven application of ISO 19650 on live projects, including experience as Lead Appointed Party or within ISO 19650\-compliant frameworks, with working knowledge of EIR, BEP, MIDP, TIDP documentation
* Demonstrated expertise delivering projects for hyperscale operators (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) with deep understanding of their Revit templates, family libraries, naming conventions, and coordination workflows
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP) including parametric modeling, family creation, phasing, worksets, design options, view templates, and advanced scheduling, with hands\-on modeling experience
* Expert\-level experience with Common Data Environments (CDE) including Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360 administration, and strong expertise in Navisworks for 3D coordination, clash detection, and 4D sequencing
* Practical experience with COBie asset data structuring and familiarity with BSRIA BG6 Building Services BIM guidance
* Proven track record delivering data center projects across design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and EPC frameworks, coordinating mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, civil, and specialist disciplines (fire protection, security, telecom)
* Significant experience with projects in GCC and broader EMEA region, with understanding of regional BIM maturity levels, local codes, and stakeholder dynamics
* Strong technical background in building services engineering with ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, understand construction methods, building systems, and MEP coordination requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to explain technical BIM concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and lead coordination meetings
* Proactive, structured approach with demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk and hold authority to challenge non\-compliant information
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; professional certifications (Autodesk Certified Professional, buildingSMART certifications) preferred


**Desired Skills \& Attributes**
* Advanced BIM tools: Dynamo for Revit automation, Solibri for model checking, Bluebeam for PDF coordination, digital twin platforms for operational handover
* Point cloud processing and scan\-to\-BIM workflows for existing facility documentation
* Computational design and visual scripting (Dynamo, Grasshopper) for design automation
* Sustainable design coordination experience (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) and energy modeling integration (IES VE, IES Apache, DesignBuilder)
* Data center\-specific BIM knowledge: hot/cold aisle modeling, cable tray routing for high\-density power, precision cooling coordination, raised floor systems, structured cabling infrastructure
* Federated model coordination strategies, including coordination sequencing, trade\-specific clash priorities, and progressive coordination approaches
* 4D scheduling integration (Navisworks Timeliner, Synchro) for construction sequencing visualization
* Understanding of data center monitoring systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS) and BIM coordination with operational systems
* Experience supporting construction phase information delivery and commissioning coordination
* Mentoring capabilities with experience guiding junior BIM coordinators and modelers
* Project management skills including planning, resource allocation, and progress tracking
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in fast\-paced environments while maintaining quality standards


**What We Offer**
* Clear career progression with increasing leadership responsibilities as the department and BIM maturity expand
* Exposure to diverse mission critical projects across EMEA, working with leading hyperscaler operators and regional data center developers
* Direct reporting to Head of Mission Critical with significant autonomy to shape BIM processes, standards, and digital design delivery
* Hands\-on involvement with cutting\-edge data center projects including campus\-scale developments, high\-density AI infrastructure, and liquid cooling implementations
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
* Professional development opportunities including training, industry conferences, and certifications

data.raw_snippet:
**Job Purpose:** 




 The Head of QA is RAKBANK's enterprise quality authority — a strategic leadership role accountable for transforming the bank's approach to software quality from a phase\-end testing gate into a continuous, embedded quality engineering discipline woven into every stage of the S
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 The Head of QA is RAKBANK's enterprise quality authority — a strategic leadership role accountable for transforming the bank's approach to software quality from a phase\-end testing gate into a continuous, embedded quality engineering discipline woven into every stage of the SDLC. RAKBANK's current testing landscape is predominantly manual, with limited automation coverage and a reactive quality culture. This role is explicitly mandated to change that reality: to build a world\-class QA practice characterised by automation\-first delivery, AI\-driven testing, shift\-left quality principles, intelligent test data management, and quality gates embedded within CI/CD pipelines. The Head of QA owns the entire quality engineering strategy, toolchain, governance, and team — partnering with DevEx, Platform Engineering, and delivery squads to ensure every software release meets the quality bar required by a CBUAE\-regulated bank serving retail, SME, and wholesale customers.
 



  





**What You Will Do:** 



* Define and own the enterprise
 **quality engineering strategy** 
 , roadmap, KPIs, and automation coverage targets.
* Establish and lead a
 **Quality Engineering Centre of Excellence** 
 , publishing standards, golden paths, and tooling guidelines.
* Govern
 **quality gates across the full SDLC** 
 , enforcing entry and exit criteria across all testing stages.
* Drive
 **shift‑left quality adoption** 
 , embedding QA into squads and promoting BDD/TDD and shared accountability.
* Own the
 **test automation programme** 
 , including framework governance and automation ROI tracking.
* Lead adoption of
 **AI‑assisted testing** 
 , including LLM‑based test generation, self‑healing automation, and intelligent prioritisation.
* Establish
 **intelligent test data management** 
 , including synthetic data, masking, and self‑service provisioning.
* Own
 **non‑functional quality engineering** 
 , covering performance, resilience, chaos engineering, and API contract testing.
* Define and govern
 **test environment strategy** 
 , enabling automated and on‑demand environment provisioning.
* Represent quality at
 **programme and release governance forums** 
 , owning UAT coordination, go/no‑go decisions, and executive quality reporting.



**What you will bring:** 



* 12\+ years in software quality engineering, including senior QA leadership experience in a bank or regulated financial institution.
* Proven leadership of a manual‑to‑automation, shift‑left QA transformation integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Deep expertise in test automation frameworks and test management platforms.
* Strong hands‑on experience with performance and resilience testing for critical financial systems.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating and governing AI‑assisted testing tools.
* Expert knowledge of test data governance, including synthetic data and PII masking.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; ISTQB Advanced Test Manager required.



  





**What We Are Not Looking For:** 




 ❌ A
 **traditional, phase‑end testing manager** 
 who treats QA as a final gate rather than an embedded engineering discipline across the SDLC.
 



 ❌ A leader
 **comfortable with manual‑heavy testing models** 
 , without a strong track record of driving automation‑first, CI/CD‑integrated quality transformations.
 



 ❌ A candidate
 **without appetite or credibility in AI‑assisted testing** 
 , self‑healing automation, or intelligent test prioritisation as part of modern QA practice.
 



 ❌ A purely operational QA head who
 **executes tests but does not define strategy** 
 , influence engineering culture, or establish enterprise quality standards.
 



 ❌ A profile
 **unfamiliar with regulated banking environments** 
 , unable to balance delivery speed with CBUAE‑grade quality, resiliency, and governance expectations.

data.jd_text:
**Job Overview**
 The Arbor School seeks a special individual for an exciting opportunity that has arisen within our school. The successful candidate will play a key role in fulfilling the school’s ecological and sustainability vision, as well as challenging students to fulfil their potential within the academic disciplines. The Arbor School is seeking a highly motivated  Head of Design and Technology to lead the Food Technology and Resistant Materials department in the Secondary School.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced teacher/leader with a passion for this subject area. The successful applicant will be able to teach students of all abilities as well as demonstrate a proven track record of securing outstanding student outcomes. Proficient and experienced in teaching Design and Technology, ideally with experience of teaching across GCSE/iGCSE and A Level/BTEC.
   

  

***Enough For All, For Ever***
 The Arbor School opened in 2018 with a very different vision of what education could and should be – experiential, authentic and inspired by the natural beauty, human ingenuity, and profound ecological and social challenges of the Arabian Peninsula.
   

  

 The cultivation of a learning community uniquely committed to understanding and restoring the health of ecological and human communities as interconnected parts of a whole requires equal parts optimism, ambition, and humility. A fundamental belief in the inherit goodness of people and their capacity to act with empathy and compassion underscores the sense of hope that is fundamental to learning for a sustainable future. The resilience and determination to tackle challenges that have grown to global proportion is essential to finding sustainable solutions and orchestrating the social changes needed to grow them to scale. The realisation that comes from recognising that we are all students – never a master – drives our commitment to ignite a lifelong love of learning.
   

  

**Role**
 Recognising the interconnected nature of the cognitive, affective, and participative domains, and their roles in shaping learning, we are pursuing a holistic approach to teaching and learning, designed to prepare learners:
   

  

* to understand the interconnected concepts of sustainability, individual and collective well\-being, and environmental and social justice;
* to find purpose, meaning and joy in their interactions with the natural world and with each other, and to seek to understand people who are different to themselves;
* to experience a sense of accomplishment and self\-efficacy through their actions at home, in school and in the wider world.


  

  

**The Arbor Promise**
 Arbor teachers are a part of a community which is inclusive, fun\-loving, and active. Arbor teachers enjoy authentic friendships with their colleagues, positive relationships with school leaders, who care for their wellbeing, and are a team in the true sense. Arbor teachers are resilient in the face of challenge, are stable and calm in the face of change, and creative and flexible when solving problems. Arbor teachers bring their passions and interests to enrich our school and are clear that there is an expectation to do so. We commit to meeting agreed deadlines, to communicating proactively with an assumption of positive intent and share a passion to provide an education of the highest quality to our students.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The successful candidate will be proficient and experienced in teaching Design and Technology with experience of teaching across GCSE/iGCSE and A Level/BTEC. You will lead the team, with responsibilities across KS3, KS4, and KS5, overseeing Design Technology.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Doing all that you can to ensure that you safeguard and promote the welfare of students (in line with Arbor’s Safeguarding framework/policy/Code of Conduct).
* Positively and actively promoting the Arbor vision, mission, and values.
* Ensuring your practice is in line with the Arbor Staff Handbook, the Arbor Support Teacher: A Framework for Outstanding Support.
* Implementing, where appropriate, school policies, procedures and expected practices, as identified by the Senior Leadership Team at the Arbor School.
* Undertake specific operational tasks as agreed upon with the Assistant Head of Curriculum, including some or all of the following areas:
