The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
   

  

 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
   

  

 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
   

  

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**
* Translate strategy into an operational plan for delivery of service and provide guidance to ensure consistent organisational leadership and day\-to\-day business running.
* Ensure effective implementation of the operating model with ownership for both onshore and offshore components, work closely with other regional functional leads across operations and wider CRM and Product teams.
* Implement agreed best practices while striving for continuous improvement.
* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.

The
 **Head of Business Intelligence** 
 will own and lead the end\-to\-end BI strategy, architecture and insight delivery across the business. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable intelligence that enables leadership teams to make faster, smarter and more profitable decisions.
 



 You will build and lead a high\-performing BI function, establish best\-in\-class reporting standards, and partner closely with Commercial, Trading, Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and senior leadership to drive measurable business impact.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial acumen and the ability to translate data into decision\-ready insight.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**BI Strategy \& Architecture** 



* Define and own the group\-wide BI roadmap across DTC and marketplace channels.
* Translate trading, pricing, merchandising, supply chain and finance requirements into scalable data models and reporting layers.
* Design and maintain a single source of truth across brands, regions and channels, despite fragmented upstream systems.
* Set clear ownership of raw data, transformed layers, business logic and reporting views.



**Data Integration \& Pipelines** 



* Lead the structuring and transformation of core data tables including orders, traffic, pricing, promotions, logistics, inventory and returns.
* Build and maintain robust pipelines to support daily, weekly and near real\-time trading decisions.
* Partner closely with technology and data teams to improve data reliability, timeliness and accessibility, and to define new data fields or views where required.



**Reporting, Dashboards \& Analytics** 



* Design decision\-first dashboards that drive action, not just visibility.
* Create standardised reporting frameworks while accommodating brand\-level nuances.
* Enable self\-serve analytics for trading, finance and senior leadership teams.



**Business Partnering \& Decision Support** 



* Act as a strategic BI partner to Trading and Commercial teams, proactively surfacing insights, risks and opportunities.
* Help evolve the organisation from reactive reporting to proactive and predictive insight.



**Data Governance \& Quality** 



* Define clear data definitions, metric logic and documentation to eliminate multiple versions of the truth.
* Implement data quality checks, alerts and reconciliation processes to ensure trust in reporting.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* 12\+ years’ experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics or Data, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Strong background in e\-commerce, fashion retail or consumer\-facing brands.
* Expert\-level SQL (BigQuery preferred) and deep understanding of modern data warehousing and modelling concepts.
* Advanced experience with BI tools such as Tableau or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar for data analysis, automation or advanced analytics.
* Strong commercial mindset with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* Experience building and scaling BI teams in fast\-growth, high\-change environments.

Our solutions are engineered entirely in\-house, giving us unmatched flexibility to innovate, customize, and deliver at scale.

 ⸻

**Role Overview** 
 The Senior Event Producer \- Dubai Run holds full operational ownership of Dubai Run, the flagship mass participation event within Dubai Fitness Challenge. The role is responsible for end\-to\-end planning, production, delivery, and close\-out of the event, working in closecoordination with the appointed mass events delivery agency, internal stakeholders, city authorities, and commercial partners.This role carries senior accountability for safety, operational readiness, participant experience,and on\-ground delivery during the live event period.
 **Key Responsibilities**
* Provide overall operational leadership for the planning and delivery of Dubai Run.
* Manage and direct the appointed mass events delivery agency, ensuring contractual scope, timelines, and quality standards are met.
* Oversee coordination with government authorities including RTA, Dubai Police, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Oversee all operational workstreams including route planning, site infrastructure, crowd management, safety planning, and logistics.
* Coordinate closely with Partnership Operations to ensure commercial branding and partner deliverables are integrated seamlessly.
* Act as the primary escalation point for operational risks and issues.
* Lead post\-event reporting, reconciliation, and lessons learned. Deliverables/MilestonesMay
* Complete onboarding and formal alignment with the Head of Operations and wider DFC Operations Team.
* Conduct a comprehensive review of previous Dubai Run playbooks, route designs, risk registers, traffic management plans, crowd management strategies, and post\-event reports
* Establish the master operational framework, key milestones, governance structure, and authority engagement strategy for Dubai Run.
* Assist with the development of initial entertainment and experiential concepts.
* Initiate early internal alignment across operations, commercial, marketing, and stakeholder teams.June
* Lead operational onboarding with the appointed mass events delivery agency, confirming scope, responsibilities, governance, and escalation protocols.
* Initiate and lead early engagement with RTA, Dubai Police, and relevant authorities.
* Oversee early route development, safety strategy definition, and traffic management planning.
* Support development and refinement of entertainment and experiential concepts, ensuring operational feasibility and alignment with event objectives.July
* Lead detailed route planning, staging strategy, and operational design in coordination with the delivery agency.
* Oversee development of detailed crowd management plans, safety frameworks, and operational layouts.
* Support refinement of entertainment concepts and integration into operational plans.
* Ensure early authority submissions and approvals are progressing.
* Maintain ownership of the master milestone plan and risk register.August
* Oversee development of detailed operational plans, route layouts, infrastructure designs, and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate commercial, branding, and partner integration requirements with Partnership Operations.
* Support finalisation of approved entertainment and experiential concepts.
* Ensure authority submissions, approvals, and NOCs are progressing in line with programme timelines.
* Identify, track, and mitigate operational risks and dependencies.September
* Lead lock\-down of all operational, production, and delivery scopes.
* Confirm final route approvals, traffic management plans, safety strategies, and contingency measures.
* Ensure entertainment, branding, and activation elements are fully integrated into operational plans.
* Conduct formal readiness and risk review sessions with the delivery agency and key stakeholders.October
* Oversee final preparations, rehearsals, and pre\-event readiness activities.
* Manage build\-up coordination, infrastructure installations, and route readiness.
* Ensure full operational readiness ahead of the DFC live period.
* Resolve high\-impact issues and manage escalations as required.November
* Lead live operational delivery of Dubai Run.
* Manage on\-ground command, real\-time issue resolution, and multi\-agency stakeholder coordination.
* Oversee decommissioning, route reopening, and site reinstatement.December
* Lead Dubai Run post\-event reporting and operational close\-out.
* Consolidate agency reports, authority feedback, and operational learnings.
* Document recommendations and formally hand over to the Head of Operations. Candidate ProfileMinimum 8–10 years’ experience delivering large\-scale mass participation events.Proven leadership in managing complex, multi\-stakeholder sporting events.Strong experience working with government authorities and public safety stakeholders.Excellent decision\-making, communication, and leadership skills.Comfortable operating under pressure during live event delivery.

**Position Overview**
**Details of the role and how it fits into the team**
 Institutional Cash and Trade (ICT) is part of Deutsche Bank’s Corporate Bank and a leading provider in payments (\#1 EUR clearer) and trade finance solutions for Financial Institutions across the globe. ICT’s product offering includes cross border payments, FX solutions, liquidity management and trade finance \& lending. Our international team is based in \>25 countries and covers clients across :140 markets. We set industry trends by being a thought leader and acting as the clients’ Global Hausbank advisor and solution provider.
   

  

 To expand our client coverage beyond top tier commercial banks and central banks across the globe, we are looking for a Client Sales Manager Fintech to join our organization effective immediately.
   

  

**What we will offer you:**
 A healthy, engaged and well\-supported workforce is better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its center.
   

  

**You can expect:**
* Life Insurance
* Accidental Death Insurance
* Permanent Partial Disability Insurance
* Private Medical Insurance for you, your spouse and dependent children
* Flexible working arrangements
* 30 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday \& Flexible Working Arrangement
* DB contributions to DIFC Employee Workplace Savings (DEWS)


**Your key responsibilities:**
* You are responsible for driving the MENA FinTech sales strategy to meet ambitious revenue objectives through new client acquisition including targeted sales and marketing campaigns
* You build comprehensive and lasting client relationships with MENA FinTech clients and prospects to win their cross\-border payments business and drive further cross\-sell
* You collaborate effectively with Product Management, Technology and Corporate Cash to drive the development of targeted client solutions based on client demand and market feedback
* You represent ICT at industry forums and client seminars as a subject matter expert for FinTechs and cross\-border payment solutions
* You manage effectively KYC/AML risk for your respective FinTech portfolio to ensure full compliance with laws and regulations as well as internal risk appetite, polices \& procedures
* You report directly to the Head of Fintech Sales for Cash \& Trade Finance and are directly responsible for sales / P\&L


**Your skills and experience:**
* Degree from an internationally renowned university, combining technical engineering education with business\- or strategic management qualification.
* Proven ability to bridge client objectives, regulatory requirements and core technology delivery. Prior hands\-on experience in technology or digital delivery roles (e.g. engineering, solutions design, system integration) strongly preferred.
* Ability to translate regulatory expectations into operating models, technology controls, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms, and to engage confidently with internal and external regulatory stakeholders.
* Strong expertise in cross border payments and liquidity management solutions. Formal training or certification in data analytics, AI for business, agile product management or service design.
* Proven experience operating in regulated financial services environment, including AML, KYC, sanctions screening or financial crime framework.
* A team player and highly motivated leadership personality who wants to succeed and drive the business forward
* Fluent in English, other languages a plus


**How we’ll support you:**
* Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
* Training and development to help you excel in your career


**About us and our teams:**
 Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. click here to see what we do.
   

  

**Deutsche Bank \& Diversity**
 Our values define the working environment we strive to create – diverse, supportive and welcoming of different views. We embrace a culture reflecting a variety of perspectives, insights and backgrounds to drive innovation. We build talented and diverse teams to drive business results and encourage our people to develop to their full potential. Talk to us about flexible work arrangements and other initiatives we offer.
   

  

 We promote good working relationships and encourage high standards of conduct and work performance. We welcome applications from talented people from all cultures, countries, races, genders, disabilities, beliefs and generations and are committed to providing a working environment free from harassment, discrimination and retaliation.

**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you energized by partnering with senior leaders to enable business success through people\-focused solutions? As Head of HR, you will work closely with leaders and their leadership teams across the Middle East with focus on UAE and Saudi\-Arabia to support the delivery of the people agenda.
   

  

 In this role, you will act as a trusted HR advisor on a broad range of people and organizational topics, helping leaders translate business priorities into effective people actions and play an important role in supporting leadership teams through change, organizational development, talent decisions, and workforce planning.
   

  

 This role combines senior HR partnering with hands\-on execution of (a.o.) HR cycle topics.
   

  

**What are my job responsibilities?**
**Strategic HR Leadership \& People Advisory**
* Act as a strategic advisor to Executive Management on all HR and workforce\-related matters
* Partner with leaders to design organizations that effectively support both operational and office\-based teams
* Translate business priorities into practical people\-centered actions that resonate across all workforce segments
* Lead employee relations initiatives, including dispute resolution and organizational interventions


**Workforce Planning, Talent \& Employee Lifecycle**
* Lead workforce planning aligned with business growth and operational realities
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and employee lifecycle processes
* Partner with leadership on hiring strategies, workforce structures, and succession planning
* Ensure smooth onboarding and integration, especially for expatriate and site\-based employees
* Ensure attraction, development, and retention of talent while maintaining workforce stability


**Employee Relations, Labour Law \& Compliance**
* Manage employee relations and labor matters in line with UAE \& KSA labor laws
* Act as a key point of contact for complex employee relations matters, with strong on\-the\-ground involvement
* Build trust with blue\-collar employees through visibility, accessibility, and consistent communication
* Support leaders in resolving employee issues, conflicts, and workplace challenges
* Ensure fair, consistent, and legally compliant HR practices
* Develop and implement HR policies and conduct audits to ensure governance and continuous improvement


**Performance, Development \& Engagement**
* Implement performance management practices aligned with business goals
* Support leaders in driving performance through effective people management
* Drive career development, succession planning, and talent initiatives
* Foster a high\-performance culture while ensuring employee engagement and sustainable workloads


**Compensation, Benefits \& Employee Value Proposition**
* Design and manage competitive compensation and benefits structures
* Lead salary benchmarking, job evaluations, and incentive programs
* Enhance benefits and offerings to meet both organizational and employee needs


**HR Operations, Systems \& Employee Experience**
* Oversee HR operations including HRIS, payroll coordination, and employee records
* Ensure smooth delivery of employee services (facilities, travel, housing, etc.)
* Manage HR systems, reporting, and workforce analytics
* Drive efficient processes while maintaining a positive employee experience


**HR Transformation, Projects \& Change Management**
* Lead HR transformation and digitalization initiatives
* Manage HR projects end\-to\-end, ensuring delivery and impact
* Drive change management with strong focus on communication, adoption, and employee impact
* Ensure change initiatives are clearly communicated and understood by all workforce segments, including non\-office employees
* Define and track KPIs to measure both business and people outcomes


**What do I need to qualify for this role?**
* Strong experience in an HR Business Partner or HR leadership role, preferably in a global or matrixed organization
* Experience partnering with senior leaders on people, workforce, and organizational topics
* Experience managing large blue\-collar or operational workforce populations
* Proven experience in employee relations, labor law, and workforce management
* Experience supporting organizational change and leadership decision\-making
* A collaborative style and confidence working across all levels


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field (master’s preferred)
* 12–15 years of HR experience, including 5\+ years in a leadership role within UAE \& KSA
* Strong knowledge of UAE \& KSA Labor Law
* Experience in HR transformation and project management


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and business acumen
* Leadership and stakeholder management
* Change management and transformation expertise
* Communication and influencing skills
* Strong business understanding and the ability to translate business priorities into people actions
* Analytical and problem\-solving abilities an end\-to\-end experience which anchors improved performance
* A pragmatic, resilient, and solutions\-oriented mindset
* The ability to work effectively in a dynamic and fast\-changing environment


**About The Team**
 You will report to Global HR BP ICS of VL and work closely with the regional VL and VI HR colleagues, and HR Functions and HR Service team.

data.jd_text:
**About noon** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East \- fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Head Chef who can help us move even faster.
 



  





 Noon’s fastest hyper\-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localized assortment of FMCG \& grocery products with delivery within 15\-minutes. Currently live across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time.
 



  





 noon’s mission: Every door, every day.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 Oversee daily production operations in the cold kitchen facility, ensuring production targets are met while maintaining food safety standards. Manage workflow, monitor team performance, control wastage, and coordinate order fulfilment to dark stores. Act as first point of contact for operational issues and ensure smooth execution of daily production schedules.
 



  




* Supervise and coordinate prep staff and assemblers to meet daily production targets
* Plan and schedule daily production based on dark store orders and demand forecasts
* Monitor workflow efficiency and adjust team assignments to optimize output
* Track and control wastage, identifying causes of excess disposal and implementing corrective actions
* Ensure order fulfilment accuracy
* Conduct pre\-shift briefings and assign tasks to prep and assembly teams
* Monitor ingredient inventory levels and report shortages or quality issues immediately
* Enforce HACCP procedures, temperature monitoring, and hygiene protocols throughout shift
* Address equipment malfunctions and coordinate with maintenance as needed
* Ensure proper FIFO stock rotation and storage procedures are followed
* Coordinate evening delivery schedule with logistics team



  





 Training:
 


* Dubai Municipality Food Safety Training certification (Level 1 minimum, Level 2 preferred)
* In\-house training on production planning, workflow optimization, and team management
* HACCP Critical Control Points monitoring and documentation
* Wastage tracking and reporting systems
* Inventory management and ordering procedures



  





**Who will excel?** 



* We’re looking for people with high standards, who understand that hard work matters.
* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.
* noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a dedicated Associate Director to lead Enablement efforts across Client Management teams within the UAE and MENA region. This role plays a pivotal part in championing standardised procedures and best practices to enhance operational excellence and risk management. You will be instrumental in fostering a culture committed to zero operational loss and first\-time right execution, acting as a subject matter expert and advisor.
   

  

**Strategy \& Enablement Standards**
* Lead the consistent implementation of Department Operating Instructions (DOIs) and embed standard work methodologies across client\-facing teams to ensure operational consistency and compliance.
* Promote a collaborative and consultative approach to risk mitigation by engaging with stakeholders to identify and address potential risk issues proactively.
* Drive the development of a transparent and open communication culture with auditors and regulators, ensuring engagement aligns with regulatory expectations.
* Elevate client management capabilities by embedding robust governance frameworks and risk reporting best practices.
* Serve as an expert resource, facilitating a culture focused on precision and operational integrity within the teams.


**Business Collaboration**
* Provide critical support for regulatory inspections and audit inquiries related to client management operations.
* Build and maintain effective cross\-functional relationships with Business Units, Finance, Risk, Technology, and Operations to align objectives and enhance team performance.
* Undertake special projects and responsibilities as assigned by the Line Manager and Country Head, ensuring delivery of agreed outcomes.


**Process Management – Credit Documentation**
* Oversee and execute key credit fulfilment processes, including comprehensive BCA reviews, preparation and validation of facility documentation, and management of security documentation.
* Ensure timely and accurate execution of the Key Control Self\-Assessment (KCSA) and Control Standard Test (CST) processes, maintaining strict adherence to internal control guidelines and deadlines.
* Monitor collateral valuations, document expirations, and ensure the issuance and discharge of credit limits are conducted seamlessly to support business needs.


**Core Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will undertake a wide range of responsibilities designed to support and enhance client management operations and compliance frameworks. Your key duties will include:
   

  

* Strategic Enablement: Lead initiatives to harmonise department operational procedures, ensuring teams consistently adhere to established standards and regulatory guidelines.
* Risk Mitigation: Partner closely with risk and compliance units to implement proactive strategies that identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks within client management processes.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Develop and nurture transparent communication channels with internal and external stakeholders including auditors and regulatory bodies to foster trust and compliance.
* Operational Excellence: Champion a culture of continuous improvement by providing training, guidance and support to Client Management teams aimed at enhancing accuracy, efficiency and first\-time right outputs.
* Credit Documentation Oversight: Manage and execute critical credit documentation tasks, ensuring all legal and procedural standards are met and documentation lifecycle is properly maintained.
* Reporting \& Controls: Oversee the implementation and monitoring of key controls such as KCSA and CST, ensuring timely completion and accurate reporting to uphold governance standards.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Engage proactively with various business units, technology, finance, and operations to streamline workflows, solve complex challenges, and contribute to collective growth.


**About Standard Chartered**
 Standard Chartered is a global banking group with a long\-standing heritage spanning over 170 years. We bring together the agility of a challenger with the strength and stability required to make meaningful impacts worldwide. Our commitment is to improve lives, create sustainable value, and foster innovation in everything we do.
   

  

 At Standard Chartered, our purpose is to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity. Our brand promise, 'Here for Good', reflects our dedication to responsible banking and long\-term client relationships. data.jd_text:
Binghatti is one of the UAE’s most dynamic and fast\-growing property brands, headquartered in Dubai. We’re known for bold architecture, visionary design and partnerships with global luxury icons such as Bugatti, Mercedes\-Benz and Jacob \& Co. With a portfolio exceeding AED 15 billion across Dubai’s most prestigious developments, Binghatti continues to transform the city’s skyline and set new standards for innovation and excellence in real estate.
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced Head of Infrastructure to lead the planning, design, and delivery of large\-scale civil infrastructure and master planning projects. The role requires a strategic leader with strong technical expertise in roads, water, drainage, and utilities infrastructure, combined with proven experience in managing multidisciplinary teams, stakeholders, and project commercial performance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Governance** 



* Provide strategic oversight of civil infrastructure design and delivery across multiple projects.
* Establish and implement design management frameworks, technical standards, and quality assurance processes.
* Align infrastructure delivery with organizational goals and long\-term development strategies.
* Lead risk identification, mitigation, and performance management across projects.



  





**2\. Design Management \& Technical Oversight** 



* Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary design teams (roads, utilities, drainage, transportation).
* Oversee concept, preliminary, and detailed design stages.
* Conduct high\-level technical reviews and resolve complex engineering challenges.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations and international standards.
* Manage approvals with authorities and regulatory bodies.



  





**3\. Project \& Commercial Management** 



* Manage project budgets, cost control, and financial performance.
* Oversee consultant contracts, scope negotiations, and deliverables.
* Support tendering, bid preparation, and resource planning.
* Ensure timely delivery within budget while maintaining quality standards.



  





**4\. Stakeholder \& Client Management** 



* Act as the primary interface with clients, government authorities, and key stakeholders.
* Lead coordination meetings, technical workshops, and executive discussions.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships to support repeat business.



  





**5\. Team Leadership \& Development** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop engineering teams and project managers.
* Manage resource allocation across multiple concurrent projects.
* Promote a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Support recruitment and succession planning.



  





**6\. Business Development** 



* Identify new project opportunities and support market expansion strategies.
* Contribute technical input to proposals and major bids.
* Develop partnerships with consultants and stakeholders.
* Strengthen company positioning through successful project delivery.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (Master’s or PhD preferred).
* Chartered Engineer status or equivalent (e.g., CPEng).
* 10–15\+ years of experience in civil infrastructure projects.
* Strong experience in infrastructure design (roads, drainage, utilities, water systems).
* Proven experience managing large teams and complex infrastructure portfolios.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Strategic Leadership \& Vision
* Infrastructure Design \& Delivery Expertise
* Commercial \& Financial Acumen (P\&L)
* Stakeholder \& Client Management
* Risk \& Governance Management
* Team Leadership \& Organizational Development



  





  





 At Binghatti, we don’t just build properties – we build legacies. You’ll join a team driven by ambition, creativity and excellence, where ideas move fast and every project makes a statement. Here, you’ll work alongside some of the brightest minds in real estate, contributing to iconic developments that define Dubai’s future. If you’re ready to be part of a company that’s shaping history, Binghatti is where your story begins.

data.jd_text:
The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
* 
+ Support contract negotiations on technical clauses and deviations.

* Quality, Safety \& Compliance (Non\-Negotiables)
+ Ensure all engineering outputs comply with international standards including:
+ IEC 60255
+ IEC 61850
+ IEC 61131
+ IEC 61439
+ IEEE C37
+ ISO 9001
+ Integrate Safety by Design principles including arc\-flash mitigation, segregation, and isolation philosophy.
+ Ensure robust documentation control, ISO compliance, and accuracy of as\-built drawings and O\&M manuals.
+ Maintain centralized engineering data repository and knowledge management systems.


**Qualifications**
**Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).** 
****Experience****

* Minimum 5–8 years in a senior engineering leadership or departmental head role.
* Experience handling multi\-million AED EPC or system integration projects is preferred


**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise** 
  

  

* Protection Engineering
+ Deep expertise in protection schemes (Differential, Distance, REF, Overcurrent, Busbar).
+ Relay coordination , system studies, and CT/VT sizing.

* Panel \& System Design
+ LV/MV panel design, heat dissipation, segregation, earthing, and wiring philosophy.

* Automation \& Communication
+ SCADA, RTU, IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 60870\-5 protocols.

* Engineering Tools
+ EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical
+ DIGSI, AcSELerator, EnerVista
+ ETAP / SKM

* Commercial Acumen
+ Strong understanding of technical specifications, BOM costing, value engineering, and project lifecycle

data.jd_text:
Are you a world\-class growth leader with a proven track record of scaling customer lifetime value (LTV) across global digital products? At Kape Technologies, we’re building the future of cybersecurity and consumer privacy through a diverse portfolio of privacy and security brands, including ExpressVPN, ExpressKeys, ExpressMailGuard, ExpressAI, Identity Defender, CyberGhost, Private Internet Access, EventVPN and Holiday.com.
   

  

 We’re looking for a VP / Director of Lifecycle \& Retention Marketing to own and scale the global lifecycle and retention engine across this portfolio as we expand into new markets and B2B opportunities. In this high\-impact role, you’ll operate at the intersection of growth, product, and data, leading a high\-performing team to shape how millions of users and businesses engage with and stay loyal to our products—while driving Kape’s evolution into a top global cybersecurity company.
   

  

 You will lead a team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle, pricing, and CRO, defining the next generation of retention through AI\-driven personalization, advanced experimentation, and world\-class customer journeys.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

 Define \& Scale the Lifecycle Growth Strategy
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle marketing strategy across all brands, with a clear mandate to maximize LTV, reduce churn, and accelerate revenue growth. Build and execute a global roadmap spanning onboarding, engagement, renewal, upsell, and winback.
   

  

 Lead a Best\-in\-Class Retention Organization
   

  

 Build, scale, and inspire a high\-performing team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle marketing, and CRO. Develop strong leadership layers, elevate talent, and foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, and impact.
   

  

 Own Monetization \& Pricing Strategy
   

  

 Drive the evolution of pricing, packaging, and monetization levers across multiple products. Partner closely with Product and Finance to optimize subscription models, promotions, add\-ons, and upgrade paths that maximize long\-term customer value.
   

  

 Drive AI\-Powered CRM \& Personalization
   

  

 Leverage cutting\-edge CRM platforms and AI\-driven tools to deliver highly personalized, data\-driven customer experiences at scale. Continuously evolve segmentation, targeting, and automation strategies.
   

  

 Optimize the End\-to\-End Customer Journey (CRO \& Lifecycle)
   

  

 Own the intersection of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and lifecycle marketing, ensuring seamless, high\-converting user journeys across all touchpoints—from onboarding through renewal.
   

  

 Build a Unified Retention Ecosystem
   

  

 Partner cross\-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to create a cohesive retention and monetization engine. Align incentives, roadmaps, and execution to deliver business impact.
   

  

 Champion Data\-Driven Growth
   

  

 Establish best\-in\-class analytics and experimentation frameworks. Deeply understand and optimize key metrics including churn, resurrection, winback, upsell, renewal rates, and LTV.
   

  

 Hands\-On Leadership in a Scaling Environment
   

  

 Operate as both a strategic leader and an execution partner—comfortable rolling up your sleeves to unblock teams, launch initiatives, and drive results, especially in a high\-growth or smaller company environment.
   

  

 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 8–10\+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, or growth marketing within high\-scale digital, SaaS, or cybersecurity businesses
* Proven track record of driving LTV growth, reducing churn, and scaling monetization
* Leadership experience managing teams of 10\+, with the ability to build and scale organizations
* Deep expertise in CRM, lifecycle marketing, experimentation (CRO), and retention strategy
* Strong experience with pricing and subscription monetization models
* Familiarity with AI\-driven marketing tools, automation, and advanced segmentation
* Highly data\-driven, with strong analytical and experimentation capabilities
* Hands\-on operator who can execute as well as lead
* Exceptional cross\-functional collaborator across Product, Sales, Data, and Customer teams
* Clear, compelling communicator who can align and inspire at all levels


**Before you apply**
* At the moment, we do not sponsor visas in the EU. For Hong Kong, we require at least two years of working experience and a university degree in a related field. For Singapore and the UK, we can only sponsor visas for mid\-career or above.
* Please upload your resume as a PDF and do not include any salary or compensation information in it.


*ExpressVPN is one of the world’s leading providers of online privacy and security services for consumers. Started in 2009, we’ve grown to have millions of active paying customers, a team of more than 700 people worldwide, and a brand recognized by hundreds of millions of people in 18 languages and more than a hundred countries. We see huge growth in our industry, and are gaining market share through strong execution.*

 We are a fast\-growing international Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Consultancy with our headquarters in the Dubai International Finance Centre (DIFC). We also have our own Technology company creating bespoke cutting\-edge RegTech solutions. Our business presence covers multiple jurisdictions with offices in the UAE, KSA, UK \& Ireland, Singapore, Porto, Pakistan, Qatar and South Africa. We provide Regulatory Governance, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Recruitment and Technology services to many clients including global, regional and local financial services institutions, governments and other industry partners.

 The Senior Manager – Compliance role will lead and oversee regulatory compliance and AML/CTF obligations across a portfolio of client mandates within the Region. The role ensures clients are fully aligned with regulatory expectations by implementing best\-in\-class compliance frameworks, conducting ongoing monitoring, and serving as the principal regulatory liaison. Reporting to the Director of Compliance, the role drives business growth by converting existing relationships into new opportunities and supporting the expansion of the compliance practice across our operating jurisdictions. * Timely execution of compliance deliverables; clients’ regulatory obligations consistently met.
* Effective communication with Regulators.



  





**Deliver high\-quality Regulatory Compliance and AML services to clients.** 



* Applications submitted on schedule; licences obtained with minimal Regulator queries or rejections. Positive client feedback. No material regulatory breaches or audit findings.

* Policies aligned with regulatory requirements; regular AML and Compliance training conducted, resulting in improved compliance awareness among clients.



  





**Audit, monitor, and improve compliance processes.** 



* Regular compliance reviews completed; identified gaps addressed with corrective action; internal controls strengthened.



  





**Manage and expand the compliance client portfolio while supporting business growth across the Region.** 



* New business opportunities identified and supported. Strengthened client retention and satisfaction. Growth in brand visibility and market presence.



  





**Continuously improve compliance and AML/CTF systems.** 



* Implementation of new processes, tools, or automation; measurable reduction in compliance risks; adoption of industry best practices.



  





**Strengthen business development and client engagement.** 



* New client acquisitions; increased market share and revenue from compliance services; successful representation at industry events.



  





**Contribute to firm culture, brand, and people development.** 



* Positive internal and external stakeholder feedback. Support in recruitment and retention initiatives. Active mentorship and knowledge sharing within the team.

* Provide ongoing compliance and AML support to clients.
* Draft, implement, and manage compliance and AML frameworks.
* Ensure adherence to local and international regulatory requirements.
* Compliance deliverables completed on time.
* Policies and procedures aligned with latest laws.
* No material compliance issues.

* Coordinate internal/external audits.
* Conduct compliance reviews and spot checks.
* Identify and remediate control weaknesses.
* Compliance reviews completed on schedule.
* Gaps addressed with corrective action.

* Deliver training on compliance, AML, and governance topics.
* Build client awareness of emerging regulations and risks.

* Support senior team in executing client mandates.
* Help with origination of new business.
* Represent the Firm at industry and promotional events.
* Positive feedback from senior team.
* New business opportunities identified and supported.
* Active participation in events.



  





**Leadership \& Communication** 



* Communicate compliance risks and obligations to senior management.
* Foster relationships with stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and clients.
* Represent consultancy professionally.
* Effective risk communication.
* Strong stakeholder relationships.
* Professional representation at all levels.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 



* Stay updated on regulatory developments.
* Refine compliance/AML systems, processes, and training.
* Implement best practices.
* Implementation of improved processes/tools.
* Measurable reduction in compliance risk.
* Adoption of industry best practices.



  





**Team \& Culture** 



* Promote j. awan \& partners’ culture and brand.
* Support talent attraction and retention.
* Coach and mentor junior team members.
* Positive internal engagement scores.
* Contribution to team development initiatives.
* Evidence of mentorship and knowledge sharing.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Regulatory Expertise \& Strategic Mindset: Demonstrable experience engaging with regulatory authorities across the region, with the ability to design and implement compliance programs that mitigate risk and drive organisational effectiveness.
* Operational Excellence: Experienced in executing compliance and AML programs efficiently, ensuring high\-quality deliverables and adherence to deadlines across multiple client mandates.
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills: Exceptional capability to analyse complex regulatory issues, interpret requirements, and translate them into actionable, fit\-for\-purpose solutions.

**Role\-Specific Competencies**

The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and f
data.jd_text:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommerce with defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the Senior eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 5\+ years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

The PMO Manager plays a key role in promoting cross\-stream alignment, implementing communication and escalation plans, and providing guidance to the project management team to achieve organizational goals.
   

  

**As a part of your job, you will:**
* Knowledge Management: Responsible for maintaining and organizing the project knowledge base, ensuring that all relevant project documentation is up to date and accessible.

**Innovation Program Manager (Full\-time, Part\-time or Consultation)** 




  





**About Setup.sa:**




 Setup.sa is a Saudi Consulting firm specializing in softlanding and market entry solutions for international companies. We pride ourselves in being a knowledge house, driven by technology.
 



 Setup.sa was able to leave a mark and build its name in the competitive Saudi market in an exceptionally short time. We are currently one of the fastest growing firms in Saudi Arabia, doubling our number of clients on a monthly basis.
 



  





 As we scale, we still strive to offer operational excellence while changing the way softlanding is done in KSA and raising the bar for the standards of service provision in our sector, pushing the expectations of the clients and the market higher.
 



  





 Being a consulting house, we exist to ensure that the process and journey for foreign companies’ incorporation and operations is done in the easiest and most cost\-efficient way possible.
 



 As this is our North Star, we could build the highest\-value solution in the market and subsequently serve some of the top companies and renowned startups around the world along with multiple government programs. We keep our promises to exceed our clients’ expectations by always going the extra mile, even if the client doesn’t get to know about it.
 



  





 The people working with us expect a lot from themselves and are interested in building solutions that change the way the industry works. They have strong ambitions to achieve exceptional success personally and professionally.
 



  





 Our team is performance\-driven and serious. And we would like to invite you to work with us and become a part of a growing company that has a credible brand name and enjoy an exceptional learning journey.
 



  





**Job Title:**




 Innovation Program Manager
 



  





**Seniority Level:**




 Mid\-senior Level
 



  





**Job Type:**




 Full\-time, Part\-time or Consultation
 



  





**Job Location:**




 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
 



  





**Role Overview:**




  





 The Innovation Program Manager leads the design and execution of incubation, acceleration and venture building programs in Setup.sa, guiding startups across the full journey from idea validation to go\-to\-market. The role focuses on building and managing the entrepreneurship ecosystem by connecting founders with mentors, partners, and investors. It also ensures the successful delivery, growth, and impact of innovation programs aligned with strategic objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  




1. Design, develop, and continuously improve incubation, acceleration and venture building programs covering the full innovation lifecycle from idea validation to go\-to\-market.
2. Identify and attract high\-potential startups and entrepreneurs locally and internationally.
3. Guide startups through key stages including problem validation, solution design, MVP (Minimum Viable Product) development, product\-market fit, and scaling.
4. Oversee the progress of startups within the program, and support founders in developing clear business models, value propositions, and go\-to\-market strategies.
5. Attract and manage relationships with investors, venture capital firms, angel networks, and funding entities.
6. Facilitate investor readiness for startups through pitch coaching, financial modeling guidance, and preparation of investment materials, while organizing demo days, investor meetings, and networking events to connect startups with funding opportunities.
7. Build strategic partnerships with corporates, government entities, and ecosystem players to support program objectives.
8. Establish a strong network of mentors, advisors, and industry experts, ensuring relevant and high\-quality support for startups.
9. Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and innovation practices to continuously enhance the program.
10. Manage program operations including planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and reporting.



  





**Required Qualifications:**




  




* Experience of 8\+ years in innovation management, entrepreneurship and startup ecosystems
* Proven experience in designing and managing incubation, acceleration and venture building programs
* Strong hands\-on experience across the full startup lifecycle from idea stage to scaling and go\-to\-market
* Deep understanding of the Saudi market and its entrepreneurship and innovation ecosystem.
* Experience in attracting and managing funding partners, investors, or venture capital relationships
* Solid experience in stakeholder management across founders, investors, mentors, corporates, and government entities
* Strong understanding of emerging technologies and innovation trends (e.g., AI, fintech, sustainability), along with proficiency in using work management tools (e.g., Notion, Asana)
* Bachelor’s degree
* Preferred: master’s degree (MBA or equivalent)
* Fluent in both Arabic and English

data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Enterprise clients don't churn because of the product. They churn because implementation fails, adoption stalls, or they never get to the outcome they were sold.
   

  

 As Lucidya moves upmarket \- BFSI, telecom, media, retail \- the complexity of deployments grows. Onboarding a large enterprise is no longer a handoff. It's a multi\-month, multi\-stakeholder programme with real financial and reputational stakes on both sides.
   

  

 This role owns that entire delivery motion. You will build and lead the team responsible for getting customers from signed contracts to measurable value \- and keeping them there. You will own the managed services P\&L and the operational rigour that separates a world\-class implementation function from a reactive project management team.
   

  

 If you are energised by building structure in complexity, are equally comfortable in a client boardroom and a resource planning spreadsheet, and want your work to directly determine whether enterprise customers succeed \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Lead delivery end\-to\-end.**
* Execute the PMO strategy across customer onboarding, implementation, migration, and ongoing managed services \- translating strategic direction into reliable, repeatable delivery
* Ensure every project is delivered within scope, on time, and within budget \- and that CSAT and NPS reflect it
* Serve as the executive escalation point when projects hit risk. You do not wait to be told \- you see it coming
* Develop, enforce, and continuously improve standardised delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid depending on the engagement)


**Own the commercial side of services.**
* Own the deal economics for managed services \- project profitability, gross margins, and commercial accountability for the delivery function
* Forecast team capacity, manage utilisation, and optimise staffing across implementation specialists, project managers, analysts, and designers to match pipeline demand
* Work with Sales to scope SOWs accurately. Overpromising at the deal stage is a delivery problem \- you have a say in preventing it


**Build and develop the team.**
* Lead a team of Project Managers, Implementation Specialists, and Programme Managers
* Mentor the team on advanced client management, negotiation, risk mitigation, and how to balance client customisation requests against platform scalability
* Build a culture of product stewardship \- the team should be Lucidya's strongest advocates for what the platform does well, not just executors of client requests


**Be the bridge between clients and the business.**
* Manage expectations on custom development by bridging communication between clients and Engineering and Product teams \- clearly, without overpromising
* Report project health, velocity, and risk to executive leadership in a way that enables fast decisions
* Partner with clients on internal capability building \- recruitment of client\-side resources, upskilling programmes, and adoption ramp plans that increase their self\-sufficiency over time
* Drive continuous improvement. Every delivery cycle should produce lessons that shorten the next one


 You are responsible for outcomes: delivery quality, margin, client satisfaction, and a team that gets better every quarter.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 7\-10\+ years of professional experience, with at least 3\-5 years leading project or delivery teams inside a SaaS environment
* You have run complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise implementations \- and you have the scars to prove it
* You are as comfortable in a C\-suite escalation conversation as you are in a weekly project status call. You know how to communicate risk without creating panic
* You understand the commercial side of services. Margin, utilisation rates, and SOW scope are not someone else's problem
* You do not manage by spreadsheet alone. You understand what motivates delivery teams and how to build a culture that takes ownership of client outcomes
* You have a working knowledge of SaaS architecture, APIs, and cloud\-based implementations \- enough to have credible technical conversations with clients and product teams
* You hold or have held a PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum certification. You apply methodology pragmatically, not dogmatically
* You are comfortable in a fast\-scaling environment where process is still being built. You improve the system while running it


**Culturally, you are:**
* Structured but adaptable
* Client\-obsessed but commercially grounded
* A builder, not just a manager
* Calm under pressure \- and you set that tone for your team


**What The Hiring Process Will Look Like**
* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Deep\-dive interview with the CRO
* Case study presentation \- delivery scenario and P\&L walk\-through
* Offer

**Build the Future of Rail in the Middle East with Mace**
 As we expand our rail capability across the Middle East, Mace is seeking exceptional talent to help shape and deliver some of the region’s most ambitious transport programmes.
   

  

 With a globally recognised track record across high‑speed rail, conventional rail, metro, and complex station environments, we are now growing our presence in the region — and building a high‑calibre talent pool to support this next phase.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Experienced Professionals Across**
* Project and Programme Management
* Cost and Commercial Management
* Project Controls and Planning


**You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Directs the coordination and delivery of programmes, aligning project execution with defined strategic objectives, vision, and outcomes.
* Establishes and maintains an effective programme delivery environment across people, organisational structure, processes, information, and technology.
* Drives performance improvement beyond baseline targets through optimisation of resources and continuous monitoring, evaluation, and refinement of systems and methodologies.
* Leads governance of safety, quality, cost, schedule, risk, sustainability, compliance, and stakeholder management to ensure consistent delivery excellence.
* Maintains comprehensive programme documentation, including plans, procedures, reports, registers, and lessons learned to support informed decision\-making.
* Builds and leads high\-performing, inclusive teams, fostering collaboration, engagement, and a culture of service excellence and continuous improvement.
* Manages key internal and external stakeholder relationships, strengthening communication, engagement, and long\-term network development.
* Ensures commercial viability and alignment with organisational objectives, while embedding innovation, digital transformation, and sustainability principles, including net zero carbon delivery.


**About You**
 You will bring proven experience in major rail or infrastructure programmes, coupled with the ability to operate in complex, fast‑paced delivery environments. Equally important is a collaborative mindset and a commitment to excellence — qualities that define how we partner with our clients and deliver lasting impact.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to be part of something evolving — to help establish, shape, and grow a rail capability in a region where investment in integrated transport is accelerating at pace.
   

  

 If you are motivated by delivering complex programmes, working with high‑performing teams, and contributing to the development of world‑class infrastructure, we would welcome the opportunity to connect.
   

  

 Join us in delivering the next generation of rail across the Middle East.

**Company Description**
 At QIMA, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust.
   

  

 Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence.
