**Position Overview**
 Solutions Engineering Head Job Description
   

  

 We are seeking a Solution Engineering Head to lead the complete lifecycle of technical client solutions from pre\-sales discovery and solution architecture through engineering delivery and production handover. This role represents the senior technical authority across client engagements, owning solution design, technical proposals, architecture decisions, and cross\-functional engineering team leadership.
   

  

 You will sit at the strategic intersection of business development, solution architecture, and engineering execution. Working directly with B2B/B2G clients, you will conduct technical discovery, design scalable system architectures, produce compelling technical proposals, lead engineering teams (backend, data, frontend, DevOps) through delivery, and ensure the implemented solution matches the vision sold. While your primary focus is architecture and delivery leadership, you are expected to be hands\-on when critical — debugging complex issues, prototyping solutions, and unblocking teams through direct technical contribution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Pre\-Sales \& Client Engagement
   

  

* Serve as the primary technical counterpart to B2B/B2G clients throughout the entire engagement lifecycle from initial discovery through production deployment and beyond.
* Conduct technical discovery and assessment sessions with clients to understand business requirements, data landscape, existing systems, integration constraints, and success criteria.
* Provide technical input for proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), and RFP responses in collaboration with the business development team.
* Conduct technical feasibility assessments and effort estimation for new client engagements, balancing ambition with pragmatic delivery constraints.
* Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling language for non\-technical stakeholders, senior management, and C\-level executives through presentations, workshops, and status updates.
* Bridge the critical gap between pre\-sales vision and engineering reality — ensuring what is delivered matches what was promised to clients.


 Solution Architecture \& Technical Design
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end solution architecture for all client projects from initial discovery through production deployment and operational handover.
* Design comprehensive backend and system architectures, including service decomposition, data modeling, API contracts, integration patterns, security architecture, and infrastructure topology.
* Produce architecture diagrams, solution blueprints, technical proposals, and implementation plans that translate client business needs into actionable engineering roadmaps.
* Make pragmatic technology choices based on project requirements, timeline constraints, team capabilities, and client context, balancing innovation with practical delivery considerations.
* Oversee architecture decisions for customized solutions, ensuring they are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with the company's core platform and technology standards.
* Define technical standards, architectural patterns, and quality guardrails for delivery projects to ensure consistency, security, and long\-term maintainability.


 Engineering Delivery Leadership
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end engineering delivery of customized solutions and client\-specific products, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, to specification, and with the highest quality standards.
* Lead small, focused delivery teams of 3\-10 engineers per engagement, often with shared or part\-time resources across concurrent projects to deliver integrated, production\-ready systems that meet client requirements.
* Define project technical milestones, identify and track delivery risks early, and drive resolution of technical blockers and architectural challenges.
* Establish and enforce code quality standards, testing practices, security requirements, and engineering best practices across all delivery projects.
* Review critical architecture decisions and code changes to maintain solution integrity, security posture, and alignment with client requirements.
* Monitor project health through delivery metrics, velocity tracking, risk assessments, and resource planning proactively identifying and mitigating risks before they impact delivery.
* Be hands\-on when needed debug complex production issues, prototype critical features, review challenging code, and unblock the team with direct technical contribution.
* Operate effectively under resource constraints: prioritize ruthlessly, negotiate scope with clients pragmatically, and personally fill capability gaps when the team cannot cover all required skills.
* Coordinate effectively with Product, Data Science, and Platform Engineering teams to leverage existing capabilities, shared components, AI/ML models, and core platform features within customized client solutions.


 Team Leadership \& Development
   

  

* Build, manage, and develop a high\-performing team of software engineers, providing technical direction, mentoring, career development support, and performance management.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, continuous learning, ownership, and customer focus within the solutions engineering team.
* Ensure high team performance, engagement, and retention by providing clear expectations, growth opportunities, constructive feedback, and recognition.
* Report to the CTO on delivery progress, team capacity, technical risks, resource requirements, and strategic technology needs contributing to broader technology strategy and organizational planning.


**Requirements**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience demonstrating technical depth and leadership capability.


**Experience**
* 7\+ years in software engineering with deep backend and distributed systems expertise, including at least 3 years in a technical leadership, engineering management, or solutions architecture role on client\-facing delivery projects.
* Proven track record of designing system architectures and leading cross\-functional teams to successfully implement them in production environments under real project constraints.
* Must be able to personally debug production issues, prototype solutions, and write production\-quality code when required — this is not a delegation\-only role
* Direct experience working with B2B or B2G clients in a consultative capacity: requirements gathering, technical discovery workshops, solution design sessions, technical presentations, stakeholder management, and executive communication.
* Experience leading cross\-functional engineering teams (backend, data science, frontend, DevOps) to deliver integrated, production\-grade solutions in consulting, professional services, or solutions engineering environments.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent client engagements, balance competing priorities, and deliver quality outcomes within timeline and budget constraints.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Strong proficiency in at least two of the following languages: Java/Kotlin, Python, Go, or TypeScript with demonstrated ability to make sound technology choices based on project context.
* Deep understanding of system design principles: service decomposition, distributed systems patterns, data modeling strategies, integration architectures, API design, scalability considerations, fault tolerance, and performance optimization.
* Strong API design expertise across multiple paradigms (RESTful, GraphQL, gRPC) and solid understanding of API governance, versioning, and documentation best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms GCP strongly preferred (Compute Engine, Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, managed services); AWS or Azure experience acceptable with willingness to learn GCP.
* Experience with both relational and NoSQL databases including Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL, Firestore, Cloud Spanner, BigQuery, and caching solutions like Redis/Memorystore.

**Role Description** 
**Role Summary** 

 The
 **Head of Client Success** 
 is responsible for end\-to\-end execution of the client lifecycle from onboarding through retention, renewal, and long\-term success. This role ensures clients consistently receive a high\-quality, high\-touch experience rooted in radical hospitality, while also driving measurable performance outcomes across retention, satisfaction, engagement, and service quality.
 



 This is an execution\-critical leadership role. The Head of Client Success is expected to turn strategy and priorities into completed work, enforce standards across the team, and maintain clear visibility into what is working, what is failing, and what must change. This person brings structure, urgency, and accountability to the client experience system.
 



 They must be highly organized, operationally disciplined, fluent in systems and CRMs, and capable of independently learning tools and teaching others. This is not a passive coordination role, it is an ownership role for execution, outcomes, and follow\-through.
 



 The Head of Client Success partners closely with Growth, Learning, Innovation, and Leadership to ensure client success is aligned with both client outcomes and business performance.
 



 This role reports directly to the Chief Operations Officer.
 



  




**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Client Lifecycle Ownership \& Execution** 
* Own the full client journey from onboarding through renewal, referral, and completion.
* Ensure consistent delivery of a high\-quality client experience grounded in radical hospitality and effectiveness.
* Proactively anticipate client needs and ensure support is delivered before issues escalate.
* Ensure fast, accurate, and professional responses across all client communication channels.
* Take full ownership of escalations and drive resolution to completion without drift or delay.
* Build retention and re\-engagement strategies that directly increase client lifetime value.


**2\. Execution, Standards \& Accountability** 
* Translate leadership priorities into fully executed workflows, systems, and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure all client success processes are not only defined but actively followed and enforced.
* Hold the team accountable to clear standards of accuracy, impact, and speed.
* Identify breakdowns in execution quickly and implement corrective action without delay.
* Eliminate ambiguity in how client success work is done, measured, and improved.
* Drive follow\-through on all client success initiatives until completion.
* Continuously refine systems and processes to improve efficiency and clarity of client success strategies.
* Turn recurring issues into permanent process fixes rather than repeated firefighting.


**3\. Team Leadership \& Performance Management** 
* LDC/LMA Client Success team with a strong emphasis on company values.
* Train team members on systems, client communication, hospitality standards, and operational processes.
* Continuously raise the performance bar through feedback, coaching, and structured improvement.
* Ensure the team operates with urgency, clarity, and consistent execution discipline.



  




**4\. Systems, CRM \& Performance Visibility** 
* Own CRM system, data integrity, workflows, and automation structures.
* Maintain accurate, real\-time visibility into client health, engagement, retention, and risk.
* Build and maintain reporting systems that clearly show performance trends, successes, and failures.
* Ensure client feedback is systematically captured, organized, and translated into operational improvements.



  




**5\. Cross\-Functional Execution** 
* Partner with Growth to ensure seamless onboarding handoffs and clear goal oriented client expectations.
* Work with Learning and Program teams to support client progress, scheduling, coaching, and outcomes.
* Partner with Innovation to provide accurate data and support to improve client experience.



  





  




**Key Requirements** 
* 5\+ years of experience in client success, operations, account management, or customer experience roles.
* 2\+ years of team leadership experience with direct accountability for performance.
* Proven track record of execution, ownership, and follow\-through in operational environments.
* Strong experience with CRMs and ability to learn and implement new systems quickly.
* Strong judgment, prioritization, and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent written and verbal English.
* Working professional proficiency in Arabic is strongly preferred.
* Experience in fast\-moving, high\-expectation environments.



  





  




**Required Skills** 
* Strong organizational and project management skills
* Expertise in social media management and scheduling tools
* Strong video ideation, scripting, and storytelling skills.
* Understanding of content analytics and insights (Meta Insights, TikTok Analytics, LinkedIn Analytics).
* Proficiency in tools like Canva, CapCut, or similar video editing apps.
* Understanding of influencer marketing workflows.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge of community marketing and community engagement tools (WhatsApp Broadcast, Discord, Telegram, Facebook Groups).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Arabic
* Data\-driven mindset to track and optimize performance metrics.



  





  




**Ideal Candidate Profile** 
* A high\-ownership operator who drives execution, not just coordination.
* Comfortable bringing urgency, clarity, and accountability to teams and systems.
* Naturally structured, disciplined, and detail\-oriented in execution.
* Able to confront reality with data and communicate it clearly to leadership.
* Independent learner who builds systems and teaches others how to use them.
* Balanced between radical hospitality and strong operational standards.
* Relentless about follow\-through and completion.

data.jd_text:
Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients, across every aspect of transport, energy and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable and resilient world. The Egis Group has over 50 years’ experience and a team of 22,000 employees in over 120 countries around the world. Joining our Group means, above all, sharing our values as a people\-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation.
   

  





 In the Middle East we're proud to be delivering some of the most iconic projects which help connect people, protect our environment and meet emission reduction targets. From motorways to tramways, nuclear power plants to smart cities, clients choose us to help them solve their most complex challenges \- delivering climate\-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industry, and the planet.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Project Manager to join our growing team in Doha, Qatar. In this pivotal role, you will lead the successful delivery of road asset management projects from conception through completion, driving excellence in infrastructure lifecycle management whilst fostering collaborative relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders. As a Project Manager specialising in road asset management, you will be instrumental in ensuring road infrastructure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards, whilst maintaining a customer\-focused approach and supporting your team through every phase of the asset management lifecycle.
   

  




* Develop and maintain strong collaborative relationships with key stakeholders, including road authorities, maintenance contractors, traffic management teams, and community representatives, ensuring clear communication of asset management objectives, performance targets, and infrastructure deliverables
* Plan, organise, and oversee all aspects of road asset management projects, from condition assessments through maintenance delivery and asset renewal, ensuring alignment with road network strategic objectives and regulatory requirements
* Identify, analyse, and evaluate emerging risks related to road infrastructure deterioration, traffic disruption, safety hazards, and environmental constraints; escalate appropriately and implement timely solutions to maintain road network performance
* Manage road asset management budgets and financial forecasts, monitoring maintenance costs, capital expenditure, and whole\-life asset costs whilst providing accurate financial reporting to road authorities and stakeholders
* Establish and maintain comprehensive asset management schedules, maintenance programmes, and renewal timelines; track progress against planned interventions and adjust strategies based on asset condition data and performance metrics
* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional teams including asset engineers, maintenance crews, traffic management specialists, and data analysts, delegating responsibilities effectively whilst fostering an inclusive work environment focused on road network optimisation
* Conduct regular asset performance reviews and stakeholder meetings, ensuring all parties remain informed of road condition status, maintenance progress, and upcoming infrastructure interventions
* Manage changes to road asset management programmes through formal change control processes, evaluating impact on network performance and obtaining necessary approvals whilst maintaining transparency with road users
* Develop and maintain detailed asset registers, condition databases, maintenance records, and performance reports that comply with asset management standards and regulatory requirements
* Mentor and coach team members in asset management principles and road infrastructure best practices, supporting their professional development whilst fostering a culture of continuous improvement in asset stewardship
* Communicate proactively with road authorities, local communities, and road users, addressing concerns about road conditions, managing expectations during maintenance activities, and ensuring stakeholder satisfaction throughout asset management programmes
* Analyse road network performance data, asset condition trends, and maintenance effectiveness, identifying lessons learned and recommending asset management strategy improvements for future road infrastructure initiatives


**Qualifications**

 \*\*Required Skills and Competencies:\*\*
   

  




* Project Management expertise with proven ability to manage projects through their complete lifecycle
* Strong project planning, scheduling, and resource allocation capabilities
* Experience in Road, Highways and Infrastructure Projects
* Have a strong understanding of Asset Management principles, standards and best practices.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders
* Demonstrated commercial acumen and budgetary control experience
* Proficiency in risk identification, analysis, and mitigation strategies
* Change management expertise and experience with formal change control processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a detail\-oriented approach
* Team leadership and management experience with proven ability to motivate and develop team members
* Time management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple competing demands
* Conflict resolution and negotiation capabilities
* Presentation and reporting skills
* Adaptability and flexibility in approach to meet varying project needs



 \*\*Required Experience:\*\*
   

  




* Minimum 8\+ years of professional project management experience
* Demonstrated experience managing projects of varying scales and complexity.
* Proven track record of delivering projects on time and within budget
* Experience coordinating with multiple internal and external stakeholders
* Experience in vendor and supplier management
* Familiarity with project management tools, systems, and software platforms



 \*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*
   

  




* Recognized Project Management certification such as PRINCE2, APM, PMP, or equivalent
* HNC/HND or equivalent qualification in a relevant discipline
* Portfolio or program management experience
* Experience in a multicultural or international project environment
* Knowledge of quality assurance and quality control processes
* Experience with Lean or Agile project management methodologies
* Background in vendor relationship management and contract administration



 \*\*Domain Expertise:\*\*
   

  




* Understanding of project governance frameworks and compliance requirements
* Knowledge of risk management and mitigation frameworks
* Familiarity with resource capacity planning and allocation strategies
* Understanding of project documentation standards and best practices
* Knowledge of performance metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for project success

 We are working with a Major Oil \& Gas operator to source for

 Title
 **: Head of Commissioning (Utilities) – LNG Project**
 Start Date: Negotiable (typically within 1 month notice)

**Job Purpose**
 Lead the team in planning and executing all commissioning activities, ensuring the EPC contractor adheres to the project schedule, safety standards, and start\-up sequences. Manage day\-to\-day coordination and reporting to resolve
   

  

 technical issues and consistently meet all contractual milestones.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**

* Provide review and approval of the deliverables prepared by the EPC\-1 Contractor, focusing on critical \- class 1 deliverables.
* Participate to engineering (Plot Plans, HAZOP, SIL assessment, 3D Model) and Constructability Reviews that are essential for a proper planning and execution of the pre\-commissioning and commissioning activities and works.
* Participate to factory acceptance tests of critical packages and equipment.
* Provide concise but comprehensive weekly and monthly reporting to the Project Controls Division Manager, including actions and mitigations as applicable.
* Provide leadership to his team to drive decisions for multi\-discipline issues. Drive alignment and decision making between the various stakeholders.
* Anticipate technical issues, changes in the work, delays and potential claims from the EPC\-1 Contractor to the EPC\-1 Project Manager and EPC\-1 Project Division Manager.
* Understand interdisciplinary dependencies to be able to make judgements on overall commissioning decisions having multi\-disciplines impacts. Applies risk management techniques to facilitate decision making.
* Identify SIMOPS with the EPC\-1 Contractor, early enough during the Project Execution Phase to provide proper planning and safe execution at site.


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering.

* 15 years experience in various project phases such as engineering, procurement, and construction, within large\-scale commissioning projects in the oil and gas industry, including 5 years of experience in a supervisory role, including acting roles, or oversight of service/vendor personnel.
* Strong leadership skills, experience leading multi\-discipline teams, EPC Contractors working in Joint Venture and working closely with operations and end\-users.
* Familiar and conversant with systemization, system completion database, pre\-commissioning and commissioning procedures, including SIMOPS.
* Proven experience with Vendors operating in the LNG industry such as but not limited to: main refrigeration compressors, liquefaction equipment, power generation, utilities, cryogenic pumps, control systems.
* Proven experience with commissioning of Process Licensed Units.
* Experience with pre\-commissioning and commissioning of large utility systems including: steam, boiler feedwater, large cooling water systems, cooling towers, desalination plant, air and nitrogen generation and distribution systems.


**Technical And Business Skills**
* Technical background as a discipline engineer and field precommissioning and commissioning execution experience.
* Good teamwork and facilitation skills.
* Good analytical, organisational and problem solving skills.
* Risk management experience.
* Capability to take work load and manage priorities.

 At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.
   

  

 Raytheon’s National Advanced Surface\-to\-Air Missile System (NASAMS) Program Team is seeking an
 **NASAMS In\-country Associate Director \- Program Management** 
 in Qatar. In this role, you will work closely with the Qatari Emiri Air Forces (QEAF) and our key OCONUS subcontractor, Kongsberg Air Defense (KDA).
   

  

 As part of the Short \& Medium Range Air Defense Systems Product Area within the Land and Air Defense Systems (L\&ADS) Strategic Business Unit, the team has successfully delivered NASAMS systems to Qatar and is now transitioning into operations and sustainment, with opportunities for product modernization.
   

  

 As the Senior Program Manager, you will report to the NASAMS Program Director within the MRAD Directorate and collaborate closely with the Qatar NASAMS Program Manager based in Andover, MA. Serving as the primary point of contact for Qatar NASAMS execution efforts in Doha, you will work in partnership with the Qatar NASAMS Program Manager to ensure a unified approach to program execution.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include managing subcontractor execution schedules with the KDA in\-country Project Manager to meet delivery commitments, supporting the CONUS Program Manager in preparing EACs and Program Review packages, and maintaining program infrastructure. This requires coordination across Raytheon functions, off\-sites, and international partners to ensure timely staffing, start\-up, and delivery of contractual products and services.
   

  

 You will lead in\-country teams for modernization, warranty, after\-sales support, repair \& return, and technical assistance, with responsibility for schedule and performance. This high\-visibility role involves daily interaction with the MRAD Directorate, regional and CONUS\-based functions, and senior\-level customer representatives, ensuring program success through cross\-functional collaboration and effective stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 This accompanied role will be in Doha, Qatar for a 2\-year international assignment on a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with potential extension.
   

  

 Ability to travel internationally (up to 25%) as needed.
   

  

 Employment is contingent upon meeting all medical requirements for overseas assignments including comprehensive post\-offer medical examination.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Oversee daily execution of the in\-country team, schedule, and performance for assigned contracts, ensuring compliance and fostering customer intimacy to support growth efforts.
* Serve as the primary operational Point of Contact for QEADF, providing procurement guidance, sustainment support, technical troubleshooting, and resource allocation for NASAMS Tactical Operations in Qatar.
* Direct in\-country team members, including site leads, warranty/logistics, quality, and technical personnel, to ensure maximum operational readiness for QEADF.
* Build strong partnerships with the major OCONUS subcontractor KDA, acting as the primary liaison between the NASAMS program office and subcontractor leadership.
* Drive timely resolution of issues, ensuring Raytheon and subcontractor concerns are addressed promptly.
* Support contract proposals, including bidding, negotiation, definitization, and start\-up processes.
* Develop and maintain a collaborative relationship with the QEAF customer, providing regular program updates and coordinating expectations with OCONUS and CONUS teams.
* Ensure subcontractor commitments meet financial, technical, and schedule requirements, escalating issues to the CONUS Program Manager as needed.
* Collaborate with internal functions, such as MRAD, Engineering, Contracts, Finance, Supply Chain, and Quality, to enhance program success.
* Manage subcontractor lifecycle deliverables and support customer program reviews and visits.
* Lead, mentor, and motivate the in\-country team to achieve program objectives while fostering a culture aligned with corporate vision and values.


**Qualifications You Must Have**
* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and 12\+ years of relevant experience or an Advanced degree and minimum 10\+ years of experience.
* PMX Certification Level 4, or ability to obtain within 12 months.
* CORE certification or process improvement equivalent.
* 7\+ years of experience in Program Management and Risk \& Opportunity Measures.
* Experience with large Air Defense weapon systems and prior military.
* Experience in program execution across System Integration, Fielding, Training, Operations, and Sustainment.
* Experience with financial analysis tools and project management tools and/or systems.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams.
* Proven ability to effectively lead a cross\-functional team in an international environment.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively work with international customers.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued Secret security clearance is required.
* U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.


**Qualifications We Prefer**
* MBA or a graduate degree in engineering.
* Experience working in MENA region.
* Experience as a Senior Non\-commissioned Officer.
* Experience in international program execution, including collaboration with large international subcontractors and US Government programs.
* Strong working knowledge of EX/IM regulations, security requirements, and subcontract formation, execution, and management.
* Skilled in developing and reviewing cost proposals, as well as preparing Proposal Review and Contract Start\-up packages for management approval.
* Expertise in supporting development, production, sustainment, and execution of complex weapon systems, preferably within the aerospace and defense industry.
* Proficient in using Program Management tools or equivalent systems.
* NASAMS program experience in execution or capture phases.


**What We Offer**
 Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
   

  

**Clearance Information:** 
 This position requires security clearance. The Defense Industrial Security Clearance Office (DISCO), an agency of the Department of Defense, handles and adjudicates the security clearance process. More information about Security Clearances can be found on the US Department of State government website here: https://www.state.gov/m/ds/clearances/c10978\.htm
   

  

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in\-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on\-site, hybrid or remote.***
 The salary range for this role is 157,200 USD \- 298,800 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.
   

  

 Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective\-bargaining agreement.
   

  

 Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short\-term and/or long\-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective\-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.
   

  

 This role is a U.S.\-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.
   

  

 RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.
   

  

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

data.jd_text:
**talabat** 
 is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 talabat is the leading food and Q\-commerce marketplace in Qatar, delivering food, groceries \& more to thousands of customers on a daily basis. We are seeking a Managing Director (MD) for Qatar who excels in dynamic, fast paced environments, with a knack for problem solving. The MD of Qatar should have an entrepreneurial, strategic mindset, with a mission to unlock new avenues of growth for talabat, whether by expanding our food business, further scaling our Q\-commerce business, or growing our ecosystem products (i.e. Subscription, Rewards, Fintech).
   

  

 The MD of Qatar will be tasked to elevate the performance of the existing organisation and simplify its operating model, maximising synergies between functions \& verticals. Team leadership and culture building are key skill sets needed to thrive in this role. The MD of Qatar will be a senior member of the talabat Management team, and will be the ultimate owner of the full P\&L (on a strategic, tactical, and day to day level).
   

  

**What's On Your Plate?**
**Role**
 In this role, you will represent the local voice to regional teams, while working closely with the Chief International Officer (CIO) and other C\-level executives to:
   

  

* Shape a seamless, effective operating model, across all business verticals (food \& Q\-commerce).
* Maximize synergies across teams, programs and verticals, and build a culture of growth.
* Define quarterly OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) and priorities for Qatar team.
* Act as the key 'customer' for the Product and Technology organization, collaborating to set priorities and solve problems.
* You will have full ownership of performance and P\&L, which includes:
+ Designing and executing the strategy and business plan for talabat in Qatar.
+ Preparing and negotiating annual budgets, ensuring EBITDA targets are met on a monthly, quarterly \& annual basis, and recommending additional investments if necessary.
+ Leading a large, diverse team across multiple programs and verticals.
+ Overseeing day\-to\-day operations in key functions such as logistics, marketing, sales, performance and partnerships, while representing the company in legal matters, public relations, communications, and government relations.
+ Identifying and analyzing opportunities for accelerated growth across various programs and verticals.
+ Leveraging data to drive decision making, whether to address day\-to\-day problems, or tackle long term opportunities.
+ Launching local, regional, and global transformational programs, and driving continuous improvement initiatives that can scale globally.


**Qualifications**
 As the ideal candidate, you will have a proven track record in driving successful operations, and implementing core strategies that impact both top\-line and bottom\-line results, preferably in leadership positions. With experience in uncovering problems and designing solutions for dynamic and fast\-paced businesses, you are passionate about your work and adept at navigating complex systems daily to deliver business impact.

data.jd_text:
**Building on our past. Ready for the future**

We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Plans, directs, supervises, and controls the execution of all business, technical, fiscal, and administrative functions of the assigned program, project, or subtask. Acts as the Company representative with the customer and selected suppliers during the program execution. Negotiates changes to the scope of work with the customer. Assists business development in understanding customer issues and business plans in order to market and secure new/additional work.
* Establishes the program requirements for all areas of the program, and monitors the draft and final deliverables for adherence to these criteria. Assigns responsibility to executing project plans for key subordinates and assesses how to utilize their qualifications and strengths.
* Provides input to performance reviews and development plans for subordinates. Promotes technical excellence as well as the improvement of the Quality Improvement Process. Mobilizes Company resources, through effective liaison with support departments, other offices, or subsidiaries, to create project teams capable of completing effective, quality work. Works with individual lead discipline engineer to develop budgets, schedules and plans for the various elements of a project. Ensures that the project meets or exceeds goals established in these plans.
* Monitors and reports to management on the progress of all project activity within the program, including significant milestones, and any conditions which would affect project cost or schedule. Works with individual lead discipline to devise and execute action plans to rectify potential cost overruns or delays, or to accommodate significant changes to the scope of work. Advises the customer and Company management of any such changes.
* Oversees establishment of Work Plan, Health and Safety Plan, Quality Assurance/Quality Control Plan and other documents for hazardous waste work. May participate in negotiations with regulatory agencies and in public meetings in support of customers. Completes other responsibilities associated with the position as may be appropriate


**HSE Management**
* Work with project manager(s) and other team members to visibly support and comply to the One\-Way program and ensure that HSE requirements are followed by all project participants


**Customer Relationships**
* Establish and maintain good working relationships throughout the project and post completion
* Identify, document and communicate the customer requirements
* Ensure effective management of multiple stakeholders


**Commercial Management**
* Ensure effective management of WorleyParsons/Customer contract, including delivery of the budget gross margin.


**Scope Management**
* Ensure effective handover from Business Development Group
* Ensure a clear definition of scope
* Ensure compliance with requirements of the contract
* Apply an effective change control process
* Manage and monitor project performance on an ongoing basis to identify issues and opportunities early and take pre\-emptive action.
* Effectively manage project interfaces, including use of High Value Engineering centres


**Time Management**
* Manage the planning of all scope elements of the project.
* Develop resource \& financial requirements from the project plan.
* Manage the design, procurement and construction activities to meet the project schedule.
* Monitor the key reports and the development of corrective action plans.
* Ensure timely and effective documentation turnover and project close\-out.


**Cost Control**
* Ensure that all estimates which are prepared for the project are accurate project estimates.
* Ensure that all proper and accurate cost reports are provided for control of the project.
* Monitor and control all cost aspects of the project to forecast costs, obtain approvals, identify trends and take action to avoid cost overruns and take advantage of opportunities.


**Quality Management**
* Ensure the project quality requirements are properly defined and fully implemented.
* Ensure the right systems are in place and that these are applied on the project.
* Ensure compliance with WorleyParsons policies and procedures.
* Implement as part of the project a lessons learned program on the project consistent with WP requirements.


**Team Management**
* Define roles and responsibilities and provide clear and focused leadership for the project team to create a vision for project success and a strategy to fit that vision


**Communications Management**
* Ensure effective communications with the project team.
* Document communication requirements.
* Ensure accurate, timely \& effective progress reporting to the Customer and internally to WorleyParsons management.
* Ensure ongoing monitoring of the communication network between project staff, the customer and third parties and introduction of changes where required.


**Risk Management**
* Identify project risks and opportunities.
* Monitor closure of all identified risks and opportunities.
* Maintain the risk management focus throughout the project duration


**Design Management**
* Set clear objectives for the design team.
* Ensure design team are aware of, and are complying with, customer's Basis of Design and applicable regulations and codes.
* Monitor design activities, inter\-discipline data flow and communications


**Procurement/Subcontracts Management**
* Set clear objectives for the procurement and subcontracts team.
* Assess procurement process throughout the project to ensure goods meet specification and are delivered on time and are within budget.


**Construction Management**
* Set clear objectives for the Construction team.
* Monitor the Construction Management function to ensure safe delivery of the project within cost and schedule objectives


**Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training**
* Full\-Time Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from an accredited university
* Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status or undertaking the same will be an advantage.


**Industry Specific Experience**
* Prior experience must include significant project experience and successful project management.
* Vast relevant experience in a supervisory and/or project management role including technical expertise.
* Mandatory experience in FEED and Detail Design for large Offshore Brownfield Projects.


**HSE Capability**
* Maintain HSE focus with the team to ensure OHSE requirements.
* Demonstrate behaviour and business practices commensurate with a culture of world’s best health, safety and environmental performance.
* Demonstrate a visible and active commitment to:
+ Personal well\-being;
+ Healthy and safe workplaces and activities; and
+ Continuously improve Worley health, safety and environmental performance.
+ Identify and report work hazards and incidents.


**Moving forward together**

**Job Description**

 The Commissioning Manager will be responsible for end\-to\-end service delivery with regards to Testing and Commissioning from design to Level 5 plus handover on behalf of the Client. The Commissioning Manager will be able to manage a very fast, diverse, and rapidly changing programmes, across potentially multiple projects at different stages.
   

  

 It is expected that the Commissioning Manager will have the gravitas to successfully influence at all levels across both internal and external stakeholders.
   

  





  

  




* Responsible for establishing and managing the programme wide commissioning plan and processes, aligned with the Clients and End\-User requirements and standards.
* Coordinate commissioning scope, commissioning levels (L1–L5\), milestones, and success criteria for all systems. In accordance with the Clients and End\-User’s requirements.
* Participate in design reviews in relation to address commissioning requirements and oversee integration into design deliverables.
* Oversee and direct the appointed CxAs to promote consistent execution of commissioning activities across all project phases/ projects.
* Work closely with commissioning agents, construction teams, and OEMs to align the design with commissioning requirements, address commissioning‑driven design issues, and incorporate red‑lines and test outcomes into the final as‑built design.
* Undertake a review of the CxA commissioning documentation, scripts, procedures and test reports to support clarity, completeness, and alignment with project requirements.
* Monitor CxA performance against programme, quality requirements, and contract deliverables.
* Facilitate coordination between CxAs, contractors, OEMs, design teams, and operations stakeholders.
* Oversee safe, controlled execution of commissioning activities in line with the project programme.
* Lead commissioning meetings, workshops, and readiness reviews (L0/L1 readiness, Pre‑FAT, FAT, SAT, IST).
* Drive early engagement with equipment vendors and contractors to confirm commissioning readiness.
* Oversee integrated testing of critical systems such as electrical power systems, cooling infrastructure, BMS/EPMS, fire protection, ICT and security systems.
* Validate that issues identified during commissioning are tracked, resolved, and closed.
* Oversee commissioning activities to promote compliance with applicable codes, standards, and best practices (ASHRAE, Uptime Institute, IEEE, etc.).
* Support commissioning teams by ensuring design intent is clearly reflected in commissioning scripts and test procedures.
* Maintain complete commissioning records including documentation, test results, redlines, checklists, and as‑built updates.
* Review system performance information to support assessment of how well systems align with performance, uptime and resiliency expectations.
* Coordinate handover activities with Operations/Facilities teams to facilitate a smooth transition to production.
* Support training, O\&M documentation review, and readiness of the operations team.
* Provide technical expertise and act as a client representative during testing and close out.
* Manage the commissioning programme in alignment with the overall project schedule.
* Identify commissioning risks and implement/ lead mitigation strategies early.
* Provide accurate forecasting and reporting to senior leadership.
* Provide regular T\&C updates/status to senior leadership with any potential issues and solutions to avoid impact on programme.
* Provide strategic advice to senior leadership in regard to T\&C processes, methodologies, plans, execution.
* Provide support and work closely with the portfolio\-wide PMO team during execution of the Clients projects.
* Facilitate lessons learned documents from each project to assist in the development of internal commissioning policies / processes. Commissioning Manager
* Support and provide input and advice during procurement of the Client’s delivery partners (contractors, consultants, CxA etc.). Including development of scope of works / scope of services / employer’s requirements from a T\&C aspect, responding to tender queries and all\-round T\&C technical support.


**Qualifications**

  

  




* Bachelor’s degree in; Mechanical, Electrical, or related engineering discipline or a relevant field.
* Recognised CxA, CCP, LEED, Project Management qualifications or anything similar is advantageous.
* Recognised Project Management qualifications are advantageous.
* Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Designer (ATD) or Accredited Tier Specialist (ATS) are advantageous.



**Skills and behaviours**



* Minimum of 8 years’ experience
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in Testing and Commissioning management
* Data Centre experience
* Previous experience within a data centre lease provider/developer environment is advantageous.
* Previous experience in the Middle East region is advantages
* Written and spoken English language skills
* Experienced in Client facing role
* Strong understanding of data centre testing and commissioning L1\-L5
* Demonstrate experience delivering commissioning across all levels (L1\-L5\)
* Deep knowledge of data centre design principles, including redundancy strategies, thermal management, electrical resilience, and Uptime Institute Tier concepts
* Ability to interpret detailed design documents, specifications, schematics, and commissioning plans.
* Understanding of relevant codes and regulations
* Proficiency in commissioning software/tools, reporting platforms, and standard office applications
* Previous experience with hyperscale data centre clients and standards/ delivery methodologies is advantageous



**Location and travel**



* The post holder will be based in our office location in Qatar, or on our client site office
* There will be a requirement for very occasional travel across the region / sites


**Additional Information**

**Company Vision:**




 Our vision is to be the leading capital programmes professional service provider operating across property, infrastructure and natural resources.
   

  





 In 2010 Turner \& Townsend began a journey to grow the company on a global scale across our three core sectors. Our vision to excel has seen us climb from 2,500 staff in 63 offices across 28 countries, in 2010, to 6,800 in 110 offices across 45 countries in 2020\.
   

  





 Turner \& Townsend recognise the fact that our employees are the key to our future growth. We invest heavily in the training, development and regular appraisal of our people: by managing each employee’s career aspirations and by promoting from within at every opportunity, we believe we have created a stimulating, challenging and exciting working environment for our staff.
   

  





 Turner \& Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

**HSSEQ \& Compliance**

**Team Leadership \& Capability**

data.raw_snippet:
**Primary Purpose Of The Job**
 To lead, manage and successfully deliver the EPIC Execution Phase for the PS3 BH Field Redevelopment Project – covering both Greenfield and Brownfield scopes— ensuring delivery within cost, schedule, quality, and HSE requirements in line with QatarEnergy's Project Man
data.jd_text:
**Primary Purpose Of The Job**
 To lead, manage and successfully deliver the EPIC Execution Phase for the PS3 BH Field Redevelopment Project – covering both Greenfield and Brownfield scopes— ensuring delivery within cost, schedule, quality, and HSE requirements in line with QatarEnergy's Project Management Framework.
   

  

 The role acts as the Project Manager’s primary deputy, accountable for day‑to‑day coordination, decision‑making, and execution oversight for all EPIC activities across engineering, procurement, fabrication, installation, pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and handover.
   

  

 The EPIC Phase Scope of Work includes, but is not limited to:
   

  

* New Production Station (PS3\) bridge connected to the existing complex, consisting of a Process (PS3K) Platform, a Utilities and Living Quarters (PS3L) Platform, MJ Separation and Compression (PS3M), Riser Platform (PS3R), Flare and interconnecting bridges with structural props.
* Brownfield Modifications to existing PS3A,PS3B and PS3C, plus HV Electrical modifications and Civil works at Halul Island.
* A structural Prop and new 4 leg jacket with topside for injection wells.
* Structural Props (support platform) at several remote WHJs.


**Required Experience And Skills**
* At least 10 years in senior Project Management roles delivering large offshore packages.
* Proven leadership delivering multi‑billion USD EPIC contracts involving Topsides, Jackets, Brownfield modifications, offshore construction, installation, and commissioning.
* Work experience in fabrication, offshore construction, and Inspection and Pre\-commissioning activities.
* Strong understanding of engineering design, offshore fabrication, load‑out, T\&I, hook‑up, pre‑commissioning and commissioning.
* Knowledge of offshore codes and standards (API, DNV, ISO) and Shell DEPs.
* Solid experience with risk management, schedule control, earned value, interface management, and change management.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills in multicultural environments.
* Strong decision‑making capability, including under pressure and with limited information.
* Ability to lead large teams (\>150 personnel) across multiple locations and time zones.


**Educational Qualifications**
* B.Sc. in an Engineering Discipline or equivalent from an internationally recognized University with 18 years minimum relevant project experience.

With the help of data and analytics, we empower our customers to make their energy systems and processes in buildings and industries more efficient and sustainable. Together with our customers, we transform the everyday for a better tomorrow.
   

  

 Join our Smart Infrastructure Grid Software team as a Project Manager and help us reimagine the world by finding solutions that make tomorrow a more innovative place.
   

  

**Reporting to: Head of Grid Software QA and BH, located in Doha \- Qatar**
**Critical Dimensions**
 The Project Manager is responsible of the overall project delivery, he will be involved from the sales engagement stage through to the technical design, commercial and legal aspects of the project and ultimately the delivery of the overall project within scope, timeline and using the allocated resources. He has profit and loss accountability of his assigned projects and will work according to the pm@SIEMENS process.
   

  

 This role reports to the Smart Infrastructure Grid Software Business Unit in Qatar and has the exposure to operate across the Middle East region.
   

  

 Additional to the above\-described role, it is also expected actively to support Sales and proposal activities directly with the customer as getting involved with the software product lifecycle team in order to guarantee solution success in the project implementation phase.
   

  

 The PM manages the engineering resources in house and at the back offices, ensures projects are delivered as per scope of work, within the contractual timeframe and using the allocated financial and human resources, as well as getting involved with the software product lifecycle team in order to guarantee solution success in the project implementation phase.
   

  

 This role requires high customer engagement and effective communication skills, inspiring leadership treats to ensure the team is working in harmony to deliver SIEMENS benefits and customer expected values.
   

  

 Additionally, the PM should have a business development and sales mindset and contribute to achieve the GSW ME order intake, revenue and profits ambitions, he should support the sales team to promote GSW solutions to the customers, create demand from customers, involve in proposals activities by analyzing RFQs and preparing a technical solution, estimate the cost and prepare a commercial offer, he should be involved in arranging workshops and participate in organizing events.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Fully understand customer objectives, and projects contractual scope and obligations
* Responsible of the Planning, scheduling, budgeting and reporting
* Maintain strong customer relationship and effective communication
* Manage resources through efficient planning and identifying required skills
* Highlighting potential opportunities and risks that should be raised to Management
* Close monitoring of the resources and subcontractors assigned work
* Review all types of documents before sending to customers
* Identify and qualify the right subcontractors with the help of procurement
* Manage projects according to pm@SIEMENS guidelines
* Drive variation orders from running projects by proper change management and promoting extra value to customers
* Prepare and conduct regional Project Review Meetings on a regular basis
* Support in building regional delivery teams, identify strengths and weaknesses, and support the improvement of the teams
* Support the regions in creating competitive, technically and commercially accurate offers and drive the respective approval processes
* Participate in field sales activities, business development initiatives to contribute to grow the pipeline and achieve sales targets.
* Define processes that can be used across the Business Unit which are in line with the global Grid SW solutions strategy
* Coordinate resources across the region to ensure we maintain productivity goals in each one.
* Support on the product development in order to insure the time to delivery of rollout features or product enhancement to comply with signed contracts or offers in build

data.raw_snippet:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers its members to perform at a higher level by providing a deep understanding of the interactions between their unique physiology and chosen behaviors.
   

  

 We’re looking for a talented leader to help open WHOO
data.jd_text:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers its members to perform at a higher level by providing a deep understanding of the interactions between their unique physiology and chosen behaviors.
   

  

 We’re looking for a talented leader to help open WHOOP Labs Doha, our first international product research facility. The Doha lab will partner with the WHOOP Labs Boston team to conduct mixed\-methods research to support physiology, user experience, and consumer studies. To serve the company’s diverse testing and validation needs, WHOOP Labs completes tens of thousands of data collections a year and creates best in class experience for our participants. WHOOP Labs Doha will set the bar for product innovation research in the GCC, setting strategy for participant experience and contributing to advancing WHOOP technology.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone with a proven track record collaborating internationally and leading a cross\-functional team, who is excited to work with our members and isn’t afraid to roll up their sleeves and get sweaty. This position is in\-person in Doha, Qatar with potential travel to Boston, MA 1\-2 times per year.
   

  

**This role is based in the Doha, Qatar. We will only consider candidates who currently live in Doha, Qatar.**
**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and execution of the WHOOP Labs Doha opening strategy, including team hiring, participant compensation structure, and setting operating hours
* Champion research integrity, including ensuring that data collection tools and team practices align with local regulations for ethical human subjects research
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of program initiatives and track progress towards goals
* Ensure clear communication between the Boston and Doha labs, developing ways of working that support multi\-facility research execution
* Represent Doha culture and unique participant experience factors in broader strategic conversations with the rest of the WHOOP human subjects research team
* Build the WHOOP Labs Doha brand and represent WHOOP in the GCC region
* Reports to the Director of Human Subjects Research


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in a field related to human subjects research such as psychology, neuroscience, exercise physiology, or consumer science
* 5\+ years of full\-time professional experience in a related area
* 2\+ years of success leading a diversely skilled team
* Experience working on a distributed international team preferred
* Deep knowledge of local culture and ability to thoughtfully communicate localization considerations for research at WHOOP Labs Doha
* Understanding of best practices regarding human subjects research, including how to obtain IRB approval for new research projects; research ethics, data privacy, and consent
* Track record of successful project management, including resource allocation, timeline management, and risk mitigation
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, ability to plan ahead while still being flexible and able to work around challenges
* Strong networking and collaboration skills, with experience in building partnerships and engaging with external stakeholders
* Ability to present findings to stakeholders and effectively communicate with company leaders
* Excitement to work in a high\-energy, fast\-paced startup environment
* Understanding of branding and marketing as it applies to research in industry spaces
* Fluency in verbal and written English, WHOOP’s working language


**This role is based in the Doha, Qatar. We will only consider candidates who currently live in Doha, Qatar.**
 Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.
   

  

 WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

* Solid understanding of project lifecycle phases (Pre\-FEED, FEED, Detailed Design, EPC).

* Experience in risk management, change management, and technical decision\-making.

* Strong problem\-solving mindset with ability to manage complexity and conflicting priorities.
* High level of planning, organization, and execution discipline.

 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. **QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION** 



* A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).

* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

Lead the successful delivery of advanced venue technology solutions across stadiums, sports venues, and large\-scale international sporting events. **Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead the overall delivery lifecycle of Venue Technology projects from concept initiation through planning, procurement, implementation, testing, commissioning, and operational handover.
* Manage RFP preparation, tendering activities, vendor evaluations, contract coordination, and post\-award project execution activities.
* Develop and maintain project documentation, governance artefacts, technical specifications, implementation plans, and reporting frameworks for all Venue Technology initiatives.
* Oversee project execution in coordination with vendors, consultants, contractors, and internal project management teams.
* Develop integrated project plans aligned with operational, engineering, and event delivery requirements across stadiums, venues, clubs, and mega\-event environments.
* Define and document functional and technical requirements for venue technology systems and infrastructure.

* Monitor project performance, risks, issues, timelines, budgets, and quality standards to ensure successful delivery outcomes.

* Lead contract performance management activities to ensure vendor compliance, service quality, and client satisfaction throughout project execution and delivery phases.

* Manage and report on the progress of all Venue Technology projects and delivery programs.

* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in Information Technology and technology project delivery.

* Experience in designing, implementing, and managing venue\-based technology solutions for international sporting events.

* Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities.

**Your day to day**
* Ensures all food is prepared fresh and is of the highest quality
* Ensure the correct preparation and presentation of dishes in accordance with menu cards and produced on a consistent basis.
* Strictly adheres to all recipes, methods and instructions from supervisor.
* Consistently checks temperatures in foods and follows proper procedures in regards to chilling, re\-heating, and holding food.
* Checks outlet upon arrival to determine status of outstanding safety, or equipment issues
* Checks outlet prior to leaving to ensure cleanliness, proper disposal/removal of food, and proper storing and labeling
* Responsible for accuracy in daily inventories and requisitions.
* Assist the Head Chef in controlling and analyzing on an on\-going basis, the following:
* Quality levels of production and presentation, including employee cafeteria.
* Guest Satisfaction.
* Merchandising and promotions.
* Operating, Payroll, Food costs according to budget.
* Sanitation, Cleanliness and Hygiene.
* Food photo sessions for all new menus – set standard.
* Maintenance of recipe cards for all menu items.
* Staff attendance, rosters
* Assist in production, preparation and presentation of all food items to ensure highest quality at all times.
* Supervise and control the kitchen to meet work requirements.
* Assist Head Chef with inspections of physical of kitchen areas including cold rooms and equipment.
* Assumes responsibilities of Head Chef in his absence.
* Assist in the preparation and testing of outlet and promotional menus following the guidelines: Requirements, competition, trends, recipes, potential cost, availability.
* Maintain and keep up to date training record.
* Ensure team members are informed about new procedures, special events in the hotel, daily functions and food cost and to received feedback.
* Ensure hygiene and sanitation, all precautions on Fire, Health and Safety are taken in the kitchen and that all employees are will trained in this aspect.
* Display good time management techniques with proper planning and control.
* Strives to continuously improve flow of production
* Check regularly perishable food items received for quantity and quality standards.
* Assist Head Chef in the planning \& ordering of food stock in accordance with the volume of business.
* Perform related duties and special projects as assigned.


**FINANCIAL RETURN**
* Assist the Head Chef in supervising the functioning of all Kitchen employees’ facilities and costs to ensure maximum Food \& Beverage departmental profit is achieved.
* Controls and decreases waste by maintaining logs to submit daily/weekly
* Observe and comply with the company’s requisition and purchase order system


**RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS**
* Comply with and ensure adherence to all of the hotel’s policies and procedures
* Comply with all occupational health and safety policies and procedures
* Attend all scheduled meetings
* Inform on a daily basis the Head Chef of all relevant information in operational matters including information, which does not require the Head Chef’s action.
* Liaise with F \& B Controls for food costing, ordering and supply.
* Liaise with departmental heads for co\-ordination of functions and activities.

* Maintain a good working relationship with all staff and colleagues throughout the hotel and sister properties.

* Maintain a positive and professional attitude at all times


**PEOPLE**
* Assist scheduling of kitchen staff to ensure proper cover of shift as per business requirements.
* Recommend increments, promotion and transfer of chefs to Head Chef and under his guidance conduct such functions as employee orientation, coaching and supervision, if necessary, to ensure appropriate productivity.
* Assist Head Chef in conducting formal on\-the\-job training session for kitchen employees.
* Utilize coaching skills and demonstrate the development of other team members.


**GENERAL**
* Communicate effectively with all other departments
* Attend meetings, training sessions and any other required meeting or training session.
* Identify opportunities to innovate service delivery and product offering to meet and exceed client expectations.
* Ensure safe work practices are adopted at all time and report any OHS concerns immediately to your direct manager or HR Manager.
* Ensure consistency in quality of appearance and taste, and the best quality menus using the freshest ingredients.
* Effectively participate in the organization of ordering, cost controlling and wastage of food.
* Lead by example and ensure all procedures (HACCP, Health and Safety, and Food Safety Management) are maintained to the required standards to which training has been received, and are being followed by all kitchen members.
* Manage and deliver the production needs of the kitchen to the required standards.
* Manage time through effective planning of work, maintaining a high level of productivity.
* Achieve customer satisfaction rating of above expectations.
* Meet maximum creativity and understanding of food, by creating dishes and assisting with menu development.
* Assigned projects are completed within designated timeframes

**Experience**

**Technical**

**Personal Attributes**
* ‘Can do’ attitude and a high level of energy
