data.jd_text:
We are looking for The Cybersecurity Engineer (CE) to be dedicated to the Schneider
   

  

 Electric Enterprise Network and Security Services team that provides lifecycle security services for
   

  

 customers.
   

  

**Key Tasks:**
 The Cybersecurity Engineer has primary responsibility for technical execution / delivery of security
   

  

 solutions to customers. While executing a Schneider Electric security solution, the CE will represent
   

  

 Schneider Electric as a technical leader with the proficiency to implement technical security solutions.
   

  

 Solutions will be composed of key elements that meet the customer needs. The CE will manage the
   

  

 implementation of solutions, perform site visits to maintain the security solution, provide security training,
   

  

 and consult on security matters when required. The CE will ensure that the security infrastructure required
   

  

 to support Schneider Electric applications is in place. The CE may also function as a requirements
   

  

 analyst and serve as the conduit between the customer and the Schneider Electric Delivery Organization.
   

  

 The CE will be required to evaluate existing and new technologies to determine their applicability and
   

  

 value for inclusion in the Schneider Electric security solutions, and communicate his or her thoughts to
   

  

 the UAE Cybersecurity Operations Manager or the Global Cybersecurity Director.
   

  

* Work with the product manager or project sponsor to successfully implement the Schneider Electric Security solutions and associated applications
* Configuration of any approved host and network security solutions
* Configuration of Network Performance Monitoring and Management solutions
* Oversee any required modification or reconfiguration of network elements
* Manage installation and connectivity testing of the security solutions
* Lead application acceptance testing (from a security perspective)
* Develop and deliver end user training
* Develop and deliver technical documentation as required
* Technical research to meet security solution requirement


**Credentials:**
* 5\+ years of experience in OT Industrial Control System
* 3\+ years performing the installation and/or management of network\-based firewalls, preferably Cisco, Fortinet, Juniper or another top\-tier product.
* 3\+ years performing network troubleshooting using sniffers and monitors.
* 3\+ years performing the installation and/or management of network\-based Intrusion Detection products.
* 3\+ years advanced systems administration (Windows Active Directory)
* 3\+ years of experience in implementing Host\-based security technologies (Antivirus, Data Leakage Prevention, Host IPS, Whitelisting)
* 3\+ years of experience in implementing system backup technologies
* Understanding of high\-availability networking technologies
* Experience working in a mixed environment of both standard TCP/IP and nonstandard networking protocols
* Experience in developing, evaluating, implementing Security Policy and Procedures
* Experience with the Schneider Electric product line and Industries is desirable but not essential
* Experience with LAN, WAN and technologies
* Facilitation skills to lead requirements discovery workshops and project scope change requirements
* Analytical skills to critically evaluate the information gathered from multiple sources, reconcile conflicts, decompose high\-level information into details, abstract up from low\-level information to a more general understanding, distinguish presented user requests from the underlying true needs, and distinguish solution ideas from requirements
* Observational skills to validate data obtained via other techniques and expose new areas for elicitation
* Writing skills to communicate information effectively to customers, Project Managers, and technical staff
* Organizational skills to work with the vast array of information gathered during elicitation and analysis to cope with rapidly changing information and be able to apply this
* Interpersonal skills, to help negotiate customer priorities and to resolve conflicts among project stakeholders


**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in a computer related field, plus one of the following certifications:
* Cisco Certified Network Associate Security (CCNA Security)
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* ISA99 or IC32\-34 related OT certification


**Competencies:**
* Based in Oman
* Independent, self\-sufficient, able to work alone without direct supervision.
* Capable of taking full responsibility for executing tasks, sometimes at remote locations.
* Confident in customer project environment.
* Able to show initiative, make quick decisions, and follow through to a conclusion.
* Travel required 50% or more during heavy project and services loads

**Job Summary**
 As the original house of luxury, St. Regis continues to redefine modern luxury through service. At the core is the Butler program, an icon to our heritage and the heart and soul of new luxury. It is high\-touch, personalized, creative and original. It is brought to life by all talent but serving as the primary face to the program is our Butler team, who are the ultimate luxury ambassadors.
   

  

 The Executive Butler is a department head with responsibility for the successful functioning and delivery of our critical and differentiating butler services to guests. You set the tone for and are primarily accountable to providing a seamless face to the guest pre\-arrival, during the guest stay and at departure. Butler services are accomplished by directly managing the Butler team – comprised of Butlers and Butler Valets – and strong coordination with other departments. The Executive Butler leads by working to continually improve guest and associate satisfaction, and maximize the financial performance of the department.
   

  

 While the St. Regis brand is steeped in history with roots that can be traced back to the early 1900s, every team member is part of a trailblazing future to redefine modern luxury through service. The Executive Butler’s success is rooted in a deep passion for service, uncompromising standards, leadership excellence, the ability to anticipate needs, impeccable interpersonal skills and technology skills to successfully lead the Butler program.
   

  

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**
**Education And Experience**
* High school diploma or GED; 2 years of experience in butler services, guest relations, or related professional area; completion of a formal butler training program.


 OR
   

  

* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; completion of a formal butler training program; no work experience required.


**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**
**Managing Butler Services**
* Manages day\-to\-day butler services operations verifying that quality and standards exceed the expectations of guests on a daily basis. This includes all pre\-arrival activities, Butler Service Desk operations, and Butler staff in order to provide a seamless butler program for guests.
* Manages VIP guests. Recognizes repeat and important guests and builds rapport in order to develop personal guest contact, obtains preferences and proactively anticipates guest needs and requirement.
* Manages VIP guests’ schedules as appropriate to support potential needs.
* Manages the guest experience so that a high level of privacy is afforded and confidentiality is kept on behalf of VIP guests when possible.
* Supervises Butler Service Desk and verifies resources provide seamless services during the on\-site guest journey.
* Conducts daily stand\-ups and communicates clear and consistent messages through stand\-ups regarding the Butler team updates and goals to produce desired results.
* Obtains list of check\-ins and VIP guests both to prepare work assignments for the Butler team.
* Keeps the Butler team focused on the critical components of operations to drive guest satisfaction and the desired financial results.
* Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among departments such as Front Office and Housekeeping whose touch points intersect with butler services and Butler team members.
* Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors and sets the bar for execution of butler services through training and mentorship.
* Continuously strives with the team to provide the bespoke and uncompromising services.
* Supports and trains other departments who deliver on signature services (e.g., housekeeping, room inspections, delivery).


**Supporting Management of Front Desk Team**
* Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
* Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
* Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
* Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day\-to\-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.
* Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
* Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.


**Guest Relations**
* Sets the standard and tone for how Butler team members drive guest relations.
* Coaches team members to recognize and build rapport with guests.
* Establishes processes to obtain guest preferences and proactively anticipate guest needs and requirements.
* Verifies Butler teams manage guests’ schedules to anticipate potential needs.
* Verifies Butler teams maintain a high level of privacy, discretion and confidentiality on behalf of guests when possible.
* Verifies Butler teams address guests' service needs in a professional, positive, and timely manner, consistent with company policy.
* Fosters positive guest relations by coaching team members to actively listen and respond positively to guest questions, concerns, and requests using brand or property specific process (e.g., LEARN, PLEASED, Guest Response, LEAP) to resolve issues, delight, and build trust. ?
* Assists other employees to verify proper coverage and prompt guest service.


**Managing Departmental Costs**
* Manages areas of operation to budget by reviewing operating statements, budget worksheets and payroll progress reports.
* Manages department controllable expenses and cost per occupied room to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
* Supervises and approves the budgeting and ordering of product and supplies in support of butler services.
* Manages departmental budget in such a way that the overall property financial goals are met, and supporting staff are educated on relevant details as appropriate.


**Conducting Human Resources Activities**
* Interviews, hires and develops Butler team members with the appropriate skills to meet the business needs of the operation.
* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position and monitors progress.
* Reviews staffing levels and modifies as appropriate so that butler services are delivered at the expected level, balanced with meeting financial and operational objectives. In reviewing staffing levels, creates monthly/weekly schedules, meeting departmental and individuals’ needs. Includes control of attendance by using software used by Human Resources Department.
* Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and verifies employees do the same within the team.
* Verifies recognition of employees is taking place across areas of responsibility.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 WSP in the Middle East is currently hiring for an Interface \& Stakeholder Manager – Aviation Projects to join our team in KSA/ UAE. The Interface \& Stakeholder Manager will be responsible for managing all project interfaces across aviation ‑ sector stakeholders, including governmental authorities, airport operators, contractors, consultants, utility providers, and internal technical teams. The role ensures seamless coordination, clear communication, and the timely resolution of interface issues that may affect programme delivery. It also involves developing and implementing structured stakeholder engagement plans to maintain alignment, avoid conflicts, and support smooth project execution. The Manager will provide regular reporting to the Project Director, highlighting interface risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies critical to the success of the aviation programme.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage all interface activities across aviation stakeholders (government bodies, airport operators, contractors, consultants, utilities, and internal teams).
* Establish and maintain effective communication channels to ensure seamless coordination between all project parties.
* Identify, track, and resolve interface issues that could affect project progress, technical delivery, or schedule performance.
* Develop, implement, and maintain structured Stakeholder Engagement Plans to ensure alignment throughout all project phases.
* Facilitate interface workshops, coordination meetings, and technical discussions with project stakeholders.
* Liaise with regulatory authorities and airport operators to ensure compliance with aviation and infrastructure requirements.
* Prepare regular interface status reports and provide interface ‑ risk updates to the Project Director and leadership team.
* Maintain a comprehensive interface register, ensuring risks, dependencies, and actions are clearly documented and managed.
* Support integration between design, procurement, and construction teams, ensuring all disciplines are aligned.


 Promote a collaborative working environment across multidisciplinary teams
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, or a relevant field.
* 20\+ years of experience in interface management, stakeholder management, or project coordination within large ‑ scale aviation or major infrastructure projects.
* Experience working with airport authorities, regulatory bodies, or large PMC/consultancy organisations (highly preferred).
* Strong technical understanding of aviation infrastructure, design processes, construction interfaces, and multi ‑ party coordination.
* Proven track record resolving complex interface issues in fast ‑ paced project environments.

data.jd_text:
We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we advise on the laws of Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey, Ireland and Jersey.
 



  





 We treat everyone as the intelligent professional they are. Our approach is to trust and empower our people to deliver consistently, and enable them to succeed. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
 



  





**Overview Of Role** 




  





 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
 



 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
 



  





 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
 



  





 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
 



  





 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.
 



  





**Duties, Responsibilities \& Person Specification** 




  




* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).
* Act as a point of escalation for the team and the business on all legal and commercial conflicts issues, analysing and resolving issues in accordance with applicable regulations, professional rules and Walkers' own policy and procedures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Walkers globally, acting as a point of contact in relation to all conflicts and client confidentiality queries and leading communications across the business in this area.
* Together with other senior team members, lead on internal training as it relates to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, share dealing and insider lists.
* Identify any weaknesses or areas for potential improvement in our existing client onboarding system (Intapp Intake) and, working with the Director of Conflicts and the Compliance Business Systems team, recommend enhancements that streamline/simplify processes for team and the business, and/or strengthen our controls.
* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.
* Input into regular reporting to senior management and/or other stakeholders as required.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.
* Keep abreast with developments in regulation, technology and the market which are relevant to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, market abuse/insider trading, and information barriers.



  





**Education, Skills \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the team's priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.
* Leadership: ability to lead and inspire the team, drive collaboration and foster a high\-performing team culture.
* Technical: deep knowledge of relevant regulations and professional rules as they relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and an ability to apply these in practice.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills: solutions\-orientated with the ability to interpret complex fact patterns to reach decisions or develop clear recommendations.
* Quality: strong attention to detail and produces high quality work product.
* Judgement: confident taking decisions, with sound judgement of when to escalate issues or seek further opinions.
* Adaptable: willingness to embrace change and uncertainty and manage competing demands in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment; willing to constructively challenge the status quo.
* Communication: strong verbal and written communication skills, ensuring communications are properly targeted, persuasive, accurate and accessible.
* Emotional intelligence: ability to empathise, understand, and manage emotions effectively, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative: builds strong and effective relationships with stakeholders and peers; works collaboratively with colleagues across the business. A "one\-team" ethos.
* Commercial: sound, commercially driven decision\-making. A relentless focus on service excellence.
* Familiarity with Intapp.



  





**Other** 




  




* Walkers is a global business and this role may therefore require audio or video conferencing outside of normal business hours.
* This role will be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office. However, our agile working policy does allow some home working each week.
* Some international travel may be required.



  





 Walkers global is an equal opportunity employer. Equality and diversity are key to our global identity and an integral part of our goal to continue being an employer of choice. We are committed to a work environment that supports all individuals irrespective of gender, ethnicity, nationality, race, religion, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other applicable legally protected characteristics. We make every effort to ensure that employment opportunities are open and accessible to all purely on the basis of personal ability.

data.jd_text:
**About us** 




 EPAM Systems is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and software development services. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Newtown, Pennsylvania, EPAM has been helping clients navigate digital transformation for over 30 years, delivering innovative solutions to stay competitive in constantly evolving markets.
 



 As consultants, designers, architects, engineers and trainers, at EPAM, we specialize in building long\-term partnerships, enabling businesses to reimagine themselves through a digital lens. In Saudi Arabia, EPAM operates in Riyadh and Al Khobar, offering cutting\-edge engineering, strategy, design, consulting, and innovation services across industries.
 



  
 



  
 



 We're looking for a
 **Director, Technology Consulting – Telecom SME** 
 to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in a hybrid working mode with onsite client presence in KSA and UAE.
 



 In this senior advisory role, you will act as a trusted partner to telecom clients, helping shape strategies and deliver innovative solutions that enable business transformation and sustainable growth. You will influence high\-impact digital initiatives, manage executive relationships and contribute to building value\-driven propositions that set our clients apart in a competitive market.
 



**The deadline for submission is 15/07/2026\.** 




  
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Act as the primary telecom subject matter expert for key clients, ensuring successful delivery and client satisfaction
* Co\-develop account plans and growth strategies in partnership with Account Managers
* Lead business transformation initiatives, product strategy and roadmap development
* Shape and scope complex solutions while defining engagement strategies and delivery governance
* Support contract negotiations and maintain accurate pipeline forecasting for predictable outcomes
* Develop telecom\-focused value propositions, pilot with regional clients and scale globally
* Drive revenue growth across assigned accounts and promote end\-to\-end capabilities of EPAM
* Establish and strengthen senior client relationships to identify additional opportunities
* Deliver against revenue and profitability targets aligned with business objectives
* Stay current with emerging telecom technologies, trends and regulatory dynamics impacting the sector







**Requirements** 



* 10\+ years of experience in technology consulting or advisory roles within the telecom domain
* Comprehensive knowledge of B2C, B2B and wholesale models as well as full\-stack implementations (channels/BSS/OSS)
* Proven ability to manage complex enterprise engagements in consulting or IT delivery environments
* Strategic mindset combined with the ability to execute and deliver measurable value
* Deep understanding of platforms, business models and innovations in the telecom sector
* Demonstrated success managing performance metrics across multiple accounts
* Expertise in consulting, strategic planning and solution delivery within large\-scale programs
* Strong network across the Middle East telecom ecosystem, including clients, analysts and partners
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills in Arabic and English
* Familiarity with GenAI technologies and ability to evaluate AI\-driven product opportunities
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; MBA or equivalent is an advantage







**Nice to have** 



* Experience in global consulting environments with cross\-functional leadership exposure
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements in the Middle East



  
 



**We offer** 



* General Organization for Social Insurance (GOSI)
* Private healthcare and life insurance
* End of service gratuity
* Annual air travel allowance for expatriates
* Corporate Programs including Employee Referral Program with rewards
* Learning and development opportunities including in\-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses



  
 



**Nature of Work and Working Hours** 




 The usual working hours for full\-time roles at EPAM in Saudi Arabia are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, including a one\-hour unpaid lunch break. Working hours may vary based on client requirements and flexibility is accommodated whenever possible.
 



**Our Locations in Saudi Arabia** 




**Riyadh** 
 \- Moon Tower, Mezzanine Floor, King Fahed Branch Road, AR Rahmaniyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
 



**Al Khobar** 
 \- 21st Floor, Khobar Gate Tower, Al Bandariyah District, King Fahd Road, Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia
 



**How to Apply, Recruitment Process and Deadline** 




 If you meet the requirements and are eager to join EPAM, simply submit your application online by clicking on "apply” and providing your up to date CV and/or LinkedIn profile and other optional materials live cover letters and portfolios.
 



 Once applied, you will have a conversation with our Talent Acquisition team, followed by a technical interview and an interview with the hiring manager; a client interview may also be included in some cases. If successful, you'll receive an offer and, upon acceptance, officially become part of our team. We look forward to welcoming you aboard!
 



 Join EPAM today and contribute to shaping the future of technology while growing your career in a supportive, global work environment.

data.jd_text:
**About Us**
 Tamara is the leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region with a mission to help people make their dreams come true by building the most customer\-centric financial super\-app on earth. The company serves millions of users in KSA, UAE and Kuwait, and partners with leading global and regional brands such as SHEIN, Jarir, noon, Amazon, IKEA, eXtra and Farfetch as well as small and medium businesses.
   

  

 Tamara is Saudi’s first fintech unicorn and is backed by Sanabil Investments, SNB Capital, Checkout.com, amongst others, operating out of its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia with other regional and global support offices.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a startup\-within\-a\-startup role. You will be responsible for building a net new banking product from scratch for the Saudi Arabia market — from ideation through design and launch.
   

  

 This role is high ambiguity, high complexity, and requires someone who thrives in uncharted territory. There is no playbook — you will write it. You must be comfortable navigating ambiguity, making tactical trade\-offs, and moving with execution velocity.
   

  

 As Product Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle of a new fintech product that will advance how merchants at Tamara manage their money. You will work daily with a full\-stack team — engineers, product designers, researchers, data analysts, operations, and business stakeholders — to ship an innovative and incredible experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the execution, vision \& strategy for a net new fintech vertical.
* Work with engineers, designers, data scientists, and commercial teams to drive the roadmap for a net\-new product.
* Be technically competent enough to be able to decide on the execution plan while managing several internal technical dependencies.
* Deeply understand the KSA Fintech ecosystem, compliance rules \& regulations — and understand how it may impact your roadmap.
* Deeply understand the operational impacts of the products we are releasing \& work with risk, compliance, treasury, customer support and others to ensure product success.
* Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor, Claude \& Codex to accelerate product development work.
* Contribute to commercial planning \& GTM of the product and own the outcomes.
* Lead a core team of engineers \& designers and drive the end to end execution forward.
* Contribute to the evolution of Tamara’s Product Management practices as AI scales our work.


**Qualifications**
* You have 4\+ years of Product Management experience, with proven experience building 0—\>1 products that have shipped and scaled.
* You have worked with early stage product teams or startups and have successfully taken a product from concept to launch.
* You have strong UX taste — you care deeply about the end\-to\-end customer experience and can hold a high bar for product quality.
* You have experience working on complex, multi\-surface products with a large blast radius of impact.
* You are a strong collaborator who works effectively with engineering, design, data, and operations teams on a daily basis.
* You are data\-driven — you have strong analytical skills, are comfortable with experimentation, and can use data to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
* You are able to think from first principles, break down complex problems, and navigate ambiguity with confidence.
* You have strong business acumen — you understand unit economics, business models, and can make decisions that balance customer value with business outcomes.
* You understand regulatory requirements and operational considerations that come with building financial products.
* You are customer\-obsessed — you aren’t shy about getting on calls with merchants, visiting them, and deeply understanding their needs.
* FinTech experience — you have worked on financial products before and understand the nuances of payments, banking, lending, or adjacent spaces.
* Must have the ability to use AI in their day to day to work. Preferred experience working in high\-growth companies.
* Arabic speaking is required for this role — you will work closely with merchants and stakeholders in KSA.


 All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

 This is a fast\-paced role that requires someone who is detail\-oriented, proactive, and comfortable navigating both technical concepts and business conversations.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving operational challenges, improving processes, and working across multiple teams to deliver merchant success at scale — this role is for you.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Serve as the primary operational and technical liaison between Tabby and partner merchants, coordinating closely with Risk, Integrations, BD, and Key Account teams.

* Manage merchant data\-enablement workflows, ensuring required data is captured, validated, and aligned with risk and underwriting requirements.
* Lead and manage negotiations with merchants about technical requirements, ensuring they understand Tabby’s data, integration, and compliance needs while balancing business objectives.
* Coordinate cross\-functional alignment on product rollouts by preparing merchant\-facing materials, supporting GTM plans, and ensuring seamless execution across teams.
* Analyze merchant performance and integration health, identify operational gaps, and propose improvements to enhance the merchant experience.
* Own and improve internal documentation and SOPs, ensuring processes around onboarding, integration, and partner success are scalable and standardized.
* Support BD teams during technical discussions with merchants, ensuring commitments made during sales cycles align with product and risk capabilities.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**
 1 year of experience in Partner Success, Technical Account Management, Fintech Operations, Payments, E\-commerce integrations, SaaS onboarding, or similar.
   

 Strong technical literacy — understanding of APIs, webhooks, e\-commerce platforms, plugins, and payment flows.
   

 Solid analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data patterns and identify issues in merchant integrations or data quality.
   

 Excellent cross\-functional communication — able to translate technical concepts into actionable steps for non\-technical stakeholders.
   

 Experience managing negotiations with merchants about technical or data requirements, balancing business needs with technical feasibility.
   

 Strong documentation skills with the ability to build processes, SOPs, and clear merchant\-facing guides.
   

  

**Nice\-to\-Have Skills**
 Experience with BNPL, payment gateways, PSPs, or e\-commerce checkout flows.
   

 Background supporting enterprise merchants and managing negotiation discussions.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary:** 




  
 



 The COO/Hospital Director will provide strategic leadership and executive oversight for entire hospital operations, ensuring the delivery of high\-quality patient care, regulatory compliance, financial sustainability, and long\-term organizational growth. He/She will partner closely with clinical and administrative leaders to drive operational excellence, develop long\-term strategies, and position the hospital as a leading healthcare provider in the region. 
 



  
 



**Job Responsibilities:** 




  
 



**Timely Commencement and Phased Commissioning** 
  
 



 Deliver on\-time go\-live and subsequent phase gates with explicit readiness criteria (licensing, staffing and training, equipment validation, safety drills, information systems, revenue\-cycle dry runs). 
 



 Publish a commissioning dashboard; maintain a risk register; escalate critical path issues with mitigation plans. 
 



 Ensure readiness of Operating Theatres, Endoscopy rooms, ICU, Laboratory, Radiology, Nuclear Medicine, and Pharmacy for each phase; conduct mock inspections and close actions before go/no\-go. 
 



 Drive the phased expansion of IP beds, ICU beds, Operating Theatres, Endoscopy suites, and new clinical specialties in alignment with the business feasibility plan, regulatory requirements, and demand forecasts. Ensure each expansion stage is backed by robust operational readiness, resource planning, credentialing, infrastructure activation, and financial viability assessments. 
 



  
 



**Strategy, P\&L and Growth** 
  
 



 Own the hospital P\&L; achieve revenue, margin, and cash\-flow targets approved by the Board. 
 



 Translate group strategy into annual operating plans and service\-line business cases for: Gastroenterology and GI Surgery, Surgical Oncology, Medical Oncology, Cardiology, ICU, Operating Theatres, Endoscopy Suites, Radiology, Nuclear Medicine, and a full\-service Laboratory. 
 



 Lead pricing and contracting with insurers and corporate clients; develop referral networks and community partnerships to grow outpatient and inpatient volumes.  
 



  
 



**Operations and Administration (Non\-Clinical)** 
  
 



 Lead Operations, Finance, Human Resources, Supply Chain, IT, Facilities, Health \& Safety, Revenue Cycle, Patient Experience \& Sales and Marketing. 
 



 Optimize throughput and access: bed occupancy, Average Length of Stay (ALOS), operating theatre on\-time starts and room turns, ICU throughput, endoscopy utilization, imaging and laboratory turnaround times, denial prevention and recovery. 
 



 Drive continuous improvement and prudent cost management without compromising patient experience.  
 



  
 



**Clinical Coordination** 
  
 



 Operate a formal cadence (Operations Council, Quality and Safety forums, weekly huddles) to align staffing, scheduling, and capacity with clinical pathways. 
 



 Jointly discuss and agree on key clinical strategies and service priorities; remove administrative barriers to clinical performance while respecting clinical autonomy. The COO/Hospital Director executes operational fixes, and the Medical Director owns clinical judgment. 
 



 Jointly monitor quality and patient\-experience indicators and implement operational corrective actions.  
 



  
 



**Regulatory, Accreditation and Compliance (Administrative Scope)** 
  
 



 Secure and maintain approvals from DHCC, DHA/MoHAP, Civil Defense, Municipality, FANR and other authorities per phase; keep all licenses current. 
 



 Representing the hospital to regulators (DHCC, DHA, MoHAP), insurers, investors, and media. 
 



 Maintain continuous accreditation readiness (e.g., JCI, ISO, CAP etc) through policy deployment, staff training, documentation, audits, and timely closure of findings. 
 



 Uphold ethical business practices, data privacy, radiation safety, and robust financial/contractual controls.  
 



  
 



**People, Culture and Physician Engagement (Administrative Scope)** 
  
 



 Build a high\-performing administrative leadership team; ensure workforce planning, productivity, and retention for clinical and non\-clinical functions. 
 



 Partner with the Medical Director on physician engagement (operating theatre access, endoscopy scheduling, multidisciplinary team meetings). 
 



 Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, service excellence, and patient\-first behaviors.  
 



  
 



**Digital, Data and Analytics** 
  
 



 Increase adoption of the hospital information system and electronic records for scheduling, documentation, coding integrity, analytics, and board reporting. 
 



 Advance automation of pre\-authorizations, inventory, and quality reporting; ensure a single source of truth for performance data.  
 



 Innovation, digital health adoption, sustainability initiatives (green hospital practices), and AI‑enabled patient care models. 
 



  
 



**Risk, Security and Business Continuity** 
  
 



 Own the administrative risk register; lead business continuity planning, facility readiness, vendor risk and cyber security; run periodic drills and report posture to the Board.  
 



  
 



**Brand, Partnerships and Community** 
  
 



 Position the hospital as a regional GI\-led center with Oncology and Cardiology anchors; build affiliations, outreach, and reputation through targeted programs. 
 



 Act as the hospital’s ambassador, building trust with patients, community leaders, and international partners. 
 



  
 



**Board Reporting and Governance** 
  
 



 Provide timely performance packs; seek approvals for capital and major contracts; ensure transparent escalations and audit closures.  
 



 Ensure effective governance processes, transparent reporting, and compliance with board directives. Support board committees with timely insights and risk assessments. 
 



  
 



**Environmental Health and Safety** 
  
 



 Ensure full compliance with all authority requirements across clinical and non\-clinical functions; adhere to organizational health and safety roles, standards, and legal obligations.

**CTG overview** 




 CTG was established in 2006, almost 20 years ago, in Afghanistan. We currently operate in 35 countries and have approximately 11,500 staff members committed to good!
 



 But do you know who we are? And what do we do?
 



  





 We provide tailored Human Resources and Staffing Solutions that support critical global initiatives across Humanitarian and Development sectors, and are now strategically foraying into new industries, including Construction, Energy, and IT, with a focus on high\-risk regions.
 



  





 Here’s a list of services we offer:
 



 •Staffing solutions and HR management services
 



 •Monitoring and evaluation
 



 •Fleet management and logistics
 



 •Facilities management
 



 •Sustainability and Communications Advisory
 



 •Election monitoring and observation
 



 •IT professional services
 



 •Medical assistance
 



 Visit www.ctg.org to find out more.
 



  





**Overview of position** 




 The Technology Director will play a pivotal role in shaping CTG’s technology vision and leading its next stage of innovation, modernization, and integration, while aligning with the broader strategic direction of the Chelsea Group. Reporting directly to the CEO of CTG, with a dotted line to the CFO of Chelsea Group, the Technology Director will be responsible for assessing CTG’s current technology landscape and defining a coherent, forward looking technology strategy. This strategy will enable growth, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver sustainable competitive advantage, while aligning with the broader strategic direction of the Chelsea Group. It is expected that CTG’s technology infrastructure will form the backbone of the Chelsea Group’s digital ecosystem, with all other group companies (with one exception) operating on this shared platform.
 



  





 This role blends strategy, technical excellence, and strong people leadership — ideal for a seasoned technology executive who can transform diverse technology ecosystems into a unified enabler of business performance.
 



  





**Growth Opportunity:** 
 This role is initially focused on CTG, reflecting the importance of technology in enabling CTG’s next phase of growth, operational excellence, and innovation. Over time, and in line with business priorities and individual impact, the successful candidate may have the opportunity to take on a broader Chelsea Group technology leadership remit, contributing to Group\-wide technology strategy, integration, and value creation.
 



  





**Role objectives** 




**1\. Define and Execute CTG’s Technology Vision, in alignment with Chelsea Group Vision** 



* Develop and deliver a clear, actionable technology strategy and 3\-year roadmap aligned with CTG’s business priorities, while ensuring alignment with the broader Chelsea Group vision.
* Partner closely with CTG senior leadership to ensure technology investments directly enable commercial growth, operational efficiency, and client delivery in complex environments.
* Position technology as a strategic value driver within CTG, moving beyond a support function to a core enabler of performance and differentiation.



  





**2\. Assess and optimise the CTG’s Technology Ecosystem** 



* Conduct a comprehensive assessment of CTG’s current systems, infrastructure, and digital tools.
* Review and evaluate software platforms purchased and used across other Chelsea Group companies to inform technology standardisation decisions and facilitate a smoother transition of those businesses onto the CTG technology structure.
* Identify opportunities for simplification, integration, and modernisation to improve scalability, resilience, and data integrity.
* Drive pragmatic optimisation initiatives that reflect CTG’s operational realities, including work in fragile and high\-risk environments.








**3\. Define the Future Operating Model for Technology (from CTG to the Chelsea Group)** 



* Establish the most effective technology operating model for CTG (centralised, decentralised, or hybrid), with a view to future scalability at Group level.
* Define clear SLAs, governance frameworks, and accountability across all technology services.
* Lay the foundations for a future Group\-wide technology model, ensuring interoperability and alignment from the outset.



  





**4\. Drive Modernization and Innovation** 



* Lead the modernization of core platforms (ERP, CRM, HCM, and operational systems) within CTG, prioritising efficiency, integration, and user experience.
* Introduce scalable, secure, and field\-adapted solutions that enhance agility in complex and remote environments.
* Leverage emerging technologies — including automation, AI, and advanced analytics — to improve decision\-making, service delivery, and cost efficiency.



  





**5\. Strengthen Cyber security and Compliance** 



* Work with the Chelsea Group Head of IT to establish and embed a robust cybersecurity framework across CTG, covering policies, tools, training, and incident response and awareness
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and client expectations across multiple jurisdictions, including government and high\-risk operating environments.
* Strengthen data privacy and protection practices across CTG, including data handling, access controls, retention, lifecycle management, and compliance with relevant privacy regulations such as GDPR where applicable.








**6\. Vendor Management \& Cost Control** 



* Manage strategic technology vendors and implementation partners, relationship and ensuring performance against agreed SLAs, KPIs and delivery expectations.
* Optimise technology costs across applications, tools, license and infrastructure and third party services, balancing efficiency with business needs and scalability
* Establish governance over all technology solutions across CTG to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, overall technology strategy, risk and cost control.
* Introduce clear governance and approval mechanisms for the evaluation, selection, and implementation of new tools, digital platforms, and AI solutions, ensuring visibility, coordination, and alignment with the central Technology function.



  





**7\. Lead, Inspire, Build and Scale (from CTG to the Chelsea Group)** 



* Build and lead a high\-performing technology team within CTG, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Act as a trusted advisor to CTG’s executive leadership, combining strategic vision with hands\-on delivery.
* Over time (2–3 years), expand leadership scope to the Chelsea Group, building a connected technology community across all companies and driving Group\-wide alignment and synergies.



  





**Project reporting** 




 This position reports to CTG's CEO with a dotted line to Chelsea Group's CFO
 



  





**Key competencies** 



* Advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field, complemented by strong business acumen (Master’s preferred)
* 10\+ years of experience in senior technology and operational leadership roles within complex, multi\-country environments
* Proven track record in technology transformation, including modernisation of ERP, CRM, and HCM systems and enterprise architecture optimisation
* Experience with integrated enterprise platforms is essential; familiarity with Odoo\-based environments would be advantageous, though not mandatory.
* Strong ability to assess, simplify, and scale technology ecosystems, with sharp enterprise systems judgement and integration mindset
* Experience defining and implementing technology operating models, governance frameworks, and vendor/implementation oversight
* Solid expertise in contract management, compliance, and risk management, ideally in regulated or high\-risk environments
* Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional, global teams and delivering large\-scale, high\-impact projects
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging C\-suite, Board\-level executives, and external partners
* Background in change management, organisational transformation, and capability building
* Analytical, pragmatic leader with a hands\-on, execution\-focused approach and ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, evolving contexts



  





**Team management** 




 The incumbent will oversee the CTG Tech \& Innovation Team.
 



  





**Further information** 




 Female candidates are encouraged to apply.

**About Atos Group**
 Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 67,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €10 billion, operating in 61 countries under two brands — Atos for services and Eviden for products. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high performance computing, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI\-powered, end\-to\-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is the brand under which Atos SE (Societas Europaea) operates. Atos SE is listed on Euronext Paris.
   

  

 The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The CTO for the Middle East \& Turkey region is responsible for leading the regional technology strategy and owning the
 **end\-to\-end presales and solutioning function** 
 for all Atos portfolios. The role acts as the primary technology advisor to customers and internal teams, ensuring that all solutions are innovative, competitive, and fully aligned with business growth objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology Strategy \& Innovation**
* Define and execute the technology vision for the MET region aligned with global CTO strategy.
* Drive adoption of Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, and Digital Platforms.
* Translate regional market trends into relevant offerings and use cases.


**Presales**
* Lead the regional presales and solution architecture function across all business lines.
* Own solution development for major bids, RFPs, and digital transformation programs.
* Ensure quality, feasibility, and competitiveness of all technical proposals.
* Strengthen partnerships (Azure, AWS, Google, OEMs) to support winning solutions.


**Client Engagement**
* Serve as a trusted technology advisor to CIO/CTO\-level stakeholders.
* Support key accounts with solution roadmaps, architecture planning, and technology advisory.
* Represent Atos in CXO engagements, technology councils, and industry forums.


**Technical Governance \& Delivery Assurance**
* Provide architecture governance and technical oversight for large regional programs.
* Establish and enforce technology standards, patterns, and best practices.
* Act as final escalation point for critical solution or design issues.


**People \& Capability Development**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team of architects and presales specialists.
* Build strong technical capability in Cloud, Data, Cyber, AI/ML, and industry domains.
* Strengthen certification frameworks and engineering excellence in the region.


**Required Experience**
* 15\+ years in senior technology leadership roles (CTO / Chief Architect / Technical Director).
* Deep expertise in Cloud, Data, Cybersecurity, AI/ML, and modern engineering practices.
* Strong experience running presales and large\-scale solution architecture functions.
* Proven engagement with senior stakeholders across Public Sector, BFSI, Energy, and Telecom.
* Strong commercial acumen and ability to influence at C\-level.


**Choose your future. Choose Atos.**

data.jd_text:
**Description:**




  





 The Smart Solutions Development Director is responsible for leading a team of software development staff with focus on business and e\-learning software application development, support, maintenance, database administration, and project management, with a mission to achieve high levels of system availability, usability, security, and client service for the university. Responsible for consulting routinely with the university stakeholders to analyze, recommend and implement software solutions for business, academic, research, and training needs.
 



  





**Main Roles \& Responsibilities:**




  




1. Oversee the supervision of department staff, including work allocation, development and training, enforcement of relevant procedures and controls, and problem resolution. Evaluate staff performance and take the needed actions to address any issues; motivate staff to achieve peak productivity and performance.
2. Ensure full responsibility for all planning and budgeting aspects of the department, including regular monitoring and assessment.
3. Ensure that university software solutions requirements and needs are met in all areas, including e\-learning, administration, academia, research, and training. Consult routinely with university stakeholders to analyze, recommend, and implement software solutions they need.
4. Proactively anticipate university future needs for software solutions and plan accordingly.
5. Ensure 100% availability of all applications, by implementing the proper technology solutions.
6. Ensure world\-class standards and best software development practices are adopted, and continuously introduce new ways to improve software development processes.
7. Ensure that software development quality standards and best practices are implemented for all stages of the software development process. Champion continuous improvement and simplification of technology and underpinning stacks.
8. Ensure high level of satisfaction among all users including learners, staff, and faculty, regarding the applications they use.
9. Continually explore, propose, and implement new approaches, technologies, and processes, to push the envelope and deliver more, better, and more cost\-effective services to the university. Ensure the adoption of the cloud native services (RDS, serverless, auto deployment, etc.).
10. Implement all ISMS manual guidelines. Follow best practices for securing applications and data. Report any security related issues immediately to VCAIT and to the AIT ISM.
11. Adhere to relevant health and safety laws, regulations, policies, and procedures.
12. Oversee, monitor, and ensure the effective implementation of Information Security Management System across the unit and periodically assess information assets and their classification, access privileges, controls, and associated risks and implement effective corrective actions and mitigation strategies in collaboration with Information Security Standing Committee and AIT division to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of university information assets.



  





**Required Qualification \& Skills:**




  





**This opportunity is available for UAE nationals.** 




  





**Professional Experience** 




 7 years of relevant software development experience including 5 years of experience in a management position
 



  





**Education and Academic Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field from an accredited University.
* AWS certifications like AWS Certified Associate and Professional level certifications.
* PMP certification.
* TOGAF certification is an advantage.
* Master's degree in a related field is an advantage.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** 



* Proven expertise in at least 4 of the following areas: native cloud solutions, application security, open source software technologies, database technologies, business process modelling and automation technologies, mobile software development, software delivery solution.
* Best practices in software development architecture and processes.
* Information technology trends.
* E\-business and e\-learning solutions.
* Leadership and management skills.
* Planning, budget preparation and fiscal management skills.
* Interpersonal skills, flexibility, and customer service orientation.
* Problem solving skills; analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to work effectively with a wide range of constituencies in a diverse community.
* Ability to provide operational guidance and leadership to technical staff.
* Strong leadership, organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent communication skills in English language; Arabic language is an advantage.

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with a leading regional bank looking for a senior executive to lead its enterprise\-wide digital and AI transformation agenda. This is a high\-impact role connecting the business, technology, and innovation, with responsibility for shaping and executing the bank’s digitalization strategy across multiple markets.
 



  





 The right candidate will work closely with the executive leadership to drive value using advanced analytics, AI, and next\-generation digital capabilities, while ensuring alignment with commercial objectives, regulatory expectations, and customer outcomes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  




* Define and drive the organization’s digital and AI transformation strategy in line with overall business goals
* Identify high\-value opportunities to embed AI and advanced analytics across core banking functions and customer journeys
* Lead the development and deployment of scalable digital and AI\-driven solutions
* Oversee innovation initiatives, including emerging technologies, and ensure practical business application
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing team of data scientists, AI specialists, and digital experts
* Partner with senior stakeholders across business, risk, technology, and compliance to ensure seamless execution
* Establish clear success metrics to track impact, adoption, and ROI of digital initiatives



  





**Required Experience \& Skills:**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or similar
* Extensive experience leading digital and AI transformation within financial services
* Strong track record of delivering enterprise\-wide technology\-driven change initiatives
* Deep understanding of AI, machine learning, and data\-driven decision\-making
* Proven ability to build and lead multidisciplinary, high\-performing teams
* Strong commercial mindset with the ability to link technology initiatives to business value
* Experience engaging with senior executives and influencing strategic direction



  





**What We’re Looking For:**




  




* Strategic thinker with a hands\-on approach to execution
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Forward\-looking mindset with a passion for innovation and emerging technologies
* Sound understanding of governance, risk, and ethical considerations in digital and AI initiatives



  





 If interested, please apply to this advertisement directly or send your CV to
 **anam.fatima@madisonpearl.com** 




  





  





**\*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted\***

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 
 : Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is responsible for leading and managing the overall technology strategy, digital transformation initiatives, cybersecurity framework, IT infrastructure, and innovation across Al Ghurair Exchange LLP. The role ensures that all technology systems, digital platforms, and operational infrastructure are aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
 



 CTO will lead the implementation and management of the company’s mobile application and digital services, ensuring secure, efficient, and customer\-focused digital solutions for remittance, foreign exchange, payment services, and customer onboarding. The role is responsible for driving innovation, automation, cybersecurity, fintech integration, and operational efficiency while ensuring compliance with Central Bank of UAE (CBUAE) regulations and internal governance standards.
 



 This role will also oversee all IT operations, digital transformation projects, cybersecurity controls, system integrations, infrastructure management, vendor relationships, business continuity planning, and technology governance to support the organization’s strategic growth and operational excellence.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities:** 




**Technology Strategy \& Digital Transformation** 



* Develop and implement the company’s IT and digital transformation strategy aligned with business goals and regulatory requirements.
* Drive technology innovation and automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
* Evaluate and introduce fintech solutions, artificial intelligence tools, automation systems, and digital technologies to support business growth.
* Ensure alignment of technology initiatives with organizational objectives and future expansion plans.



**Mobile Application \& Digital Platforms** 



* Lead the design, development, implementation, and management of the company’s mobile application and digital services.
* Introduce digital services including:
* Online remittance
* Digital onboarding
* KYC verification
* Bill payments
* Transaction tracking
* Customer notifications
* Loyalty and rewards integration
* Digital wallet and payment integrations
* Ensure the mobile application and digital platforms comply with CBUAE regulations, AML/KYC requirements, and cybersecurity standards.
* Monitor digital platform performance, customer adoption, uptime, and service enhancements.



**IT Infrastructure \& Operations** 



* Oversee all IT infrastructure including servers, networks, cloud systems, branch connectivity, VPNs, communication systems, and transactional platforms.
* Ensure high availability, reliability, scalability, and performance of all systems and applications.
* Manage and support all exchange systems, remittance systems, WPS systems, and operational platforms.
* Ensure proper backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes are maintained and tested regularly.



**Technology Strategy \& Digital Transformation** 



* Emphasis on AI first strategy and frameworks under the guidelines and best practices of UAE Smart Govt.
* Responsible for developing, executing, and overseeing organization's AI strategy.
* Ensure ethical, compliant, and efficient AI adoption across departments.
* Fostering AI literacy and building teams to support adoption.
* Drive collaborative engagements between IT teams and Business units to bridge gaps and attain business goals
 **.**



**Cybersecurity \& Risk Management** 



* Establish and maintain strong cybersecurity frameworks and controls to protect company systems, customer data, and digital platforms.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and cybersecurity risk reviews.
* Ensure proper user access management, system monitoring, endpoint security, and incident response procedures are implemented.
* Lead cybersecurity awareness and training programs for employees.
* Manage cybersecurity incidents, investigations, and corrective actions.



**Regulatory Compliance \& Governance** 



* Ensure all technology operations comply with CBUAE regulations, cybersecurity standards, AML/KYC requirements, and internal governance policies.
* Support internal and external audits by ensuring proper documentation, controls, evidence, and compliance reporting.
* Develop and maintain IT policies, SOPs, governance frameworks, and technology standards.
* Ensure proper segregation of duties, access controls, and system authorization processes are maintained.



**Vendor \& Project Management** 



* Manage relationships with IT vendors, software providers, fintech partners, telecom providers, and system integrators.
* Lead end\-to\-end IT projects, digital initiatives, and system implementation activities.
* Negotiate contracts, SLAs, licensing agreements, and technology partnerships.
* Ensure technology projects are completed within approved timelines, budgets, and quality standards.



**Leadership \& Team Management** 



* Lead and manage the IT and digital teams while ensuring effective performance management and succession planning.
* Develop a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the technology function.
* Ensure continuous technical and cybersecurity training for IT employees.
* Support management and departments with technology\-related guidance and operational improvements.



**Reporting \& Business Intelligence** 



* Develop dashboards, management reports, and business intelligence systems to support operational monitoring and strategic decision\-making.
* Monitor system performance, technology risks, customer feedback, and digital adoption trends.
* Provide regular technology updates and strategic recommendations to senior management and the Board.



  
 



**Financial KPIs** 



* Successful launch and implementation of company mobile application
* Increase in digital customer adoption and digital transactions
* System uptime achievement across all critical systems and platforms
* Number of cybersecurity incidents and technology breaches
* IT audit findings closure rate
* Reduction in operational disruptions and system downtime
* Completion of IT projects within approved timelines and budgets
* Improvement in operational efficiency through automation initiatives
* Customer satisfaction related to digital services and technology platforms
* Vendor SLA compliance and service performance
* Business continuity and disaster recovery testing completion
* Reduction in manual operational processes
* IT support ticket resolution within SLA timelines
* Compliance with CBUAE technology and cybersecurity requirements



  





**Technical \& Functional Competencies:** 



* Digital Transformation \& Innovation
* IT Infrastructure Management
* Cybersecurity \& Risk Management
* Mobile Application \& Digital Platform Management
* Cloud Systems \& Network Administration
* Payment Systems \& Fintech Integration
* Regulatory Compliance \& IT Governance
* Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery
* IT Project \& Vendor Management
* Data Analytics \& Business Intelligence



  





**Behavioral Competencies:** 



* Strategic Leadership
* Innovation \& Problem Solving
* Decision Making \& Accountability
* Communication \& Stakeholder Management
* Team Leadership \& Coaching
* Analytical Thinking
* Change Management
* Adaptability \& Continuous Improvement
* Attention to Detail
* Risk Awareness \& Ethical Conduct



  





**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master’s Degree preferred).
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in Information Technology and Digital Transformation within Banking, Exchange House, Financial Services, or Fintech industry.
* Minimum 5 years in a senior technology leadership role.
* Proven experience in mobile application implementation and digital transformation projects.



 Strong knowledge of:
 


* Exchange and remittance systems
* Cybersecurity frameworks
* Cloud infrastructure
* Digital banking and fintech solutions
* Payment systems and integrations
* IT governance and compliance
* Strong understanding of CBUAE regulations, cybersecurity standards, and AML/KYC requirements applicable to financial institutions.



 ·Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, PMP, ITIL, CEH, or Cloud certifications will be an advantage.
 



  
 



**Other Requirements:** 



* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple critical technology projects simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of financial technology trends and digital innovation.
* Ability to interact with regulators, auditors, vendors, and senior management professionally.
* High ethical standards, confidentiality, and risk management awareness.
* Resilient and able to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
